tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so//

dus 'khor man ngag lugs/ ༄༅// dpal sa skya'i khyung pod las/ dkar chag thub bstan mi mjed ma zhes bya ba/ na maḥshrī ga ru ḍā ya/ thub pa'i bstan pa mi mjed 'jig rten khams// gling mchog lho yi 'dzam gling dag pa na// rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal ldan dus 'khor bzhugs// don 'grel las tshogs mang zhing man ngag yod// nā ro pa nas brgyud pa ma 'dres pa// sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs man ngag 'di// kun la med pas gdams pa dam par gyis// g.yo sgyu zol zog can la shor ra re// rin chen gser gyis bslu yang rab tu gsang*// bla ma'i bka' rgya yod pas kun la gsang*// 'dir bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo khros pa'i ngo bo/ rdo rje khyung khra'i sgom bzlas byed par 'dod pas gnas yid dang mthun par/ bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas sbyor ba las tshogs la bya nad khyi smyon gnam drang srong gsum gyi bcos thabs/ dug bcos thabs/ dug bsten pa'i man ngag sa bdag bcos pa'i thabs/ lhog pa/ sdig pa/ sbrul/ sre mong rnams kyis so btab pa bcos thabs/ thog srung ba dang*/ bcos pa'i man ngag nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la man ngag gis bcos thabs/ bum pa'i cho ga dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang*/ rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga dang*/ bstod pa la sogs pa'i las tshogs rgyas pa rnams ni 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad cing*/ las mtha' so so dang*/ zhal shes man ngag gi gsal kha rnams ni kho sngags 'chang gzung la dpal ba bos byas so// 'di rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi gser chos lags pas dbang dang rjes gnang ma byin par dpe yang ma ston cig/ ༈ /rdo rje khyung gi las tshogs las bya bcos thabs bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ki gu ru ḍā ya/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga'i nang nas dza mi ka'i bcos thabs 'di la/ brtag thabs/ gso thabs/ phyi 'phro bcad pa dang gsum/

'di ni sngags pa nus pa chung ba'i dus 'byung ba yin pas/ steng gdon 'og gdon dang sdong*/ khyad par 'og gdon dang sdong ba yin no// dang po la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ dang po phyi la gsus pa che/ rkang lag phra/ mig zlum/ bkrag med/ skra ngan la ser/ sen mo mi grugs/ mchu gtsang*/ chu grangs mang*/ chu bongs chung*/ chu la bye ma'am khrag yod/ mgo bo'i gling che/ mthe mo khu tshur byed/ ljid chung*/ skad phra/ khyad par steng 'og bar gsum gang nas bzung pa'i sha 'bros/ stod smad la sha khra dang thig le 'byung*/ gnyis pa nang la/ mig gi steng nas mar rtsa ris mdung btsugs pa 'dra ba ni/ stod nas bzung*/ 'og nas kha smad nas bzung ba'i/ lud pa 'dra ba/ bar nas nya rgya sbrel bar nas bzung ba yin/ ba 'dra ba/ nyug pa sla/ mtsho la slebs nas ldog pa dka'/ spyir rtsa ris mang ba/ sngo la nag pa rgyu ma khrag gis brgyangs pa 'dra ba/ nag thig klu/ ser thig sa/ dmar po btsan/ sngon po dmu/ dkar po rgyal po sogs kyis rgyab brten/ bya khyi gnam gsum ka la shes par bya'o// gsum pa gsang ba'i rtags ni/ bya rgyal po gsum/ blon po gsum/ phyag tshang ba gsum/ so pa gsum/ las mkhan dgu/ pha dang ma dang bus bzung ba/ nad tshad pa 'dra ba/ rlung nad kyi rigs brtag pa dang rtsa lngas ston/ dang po rā dza ti pa bya ba yin/ rtags lag pa dang mig g.yas la ri mo 'ong*/ thig le nag po 'byung*/ gnyis pa rā dza na ga spun ces bya ba yin/ rtags mig dang lag pa g.yon pa la ri mo 'ong*/ thig le dmar po 'ong*/ gsum pa rā dza shing bya ba yin/ rtags rna ba la ri mo yal ga med pa 'ong*/ ri mo bar chad pa yong*/ bzhi pa blon po gsum gyi/ bya blon dgug pa bya ba yin/ rtags 'tshogs ma la 'ong*/ lnga pa bya ko dril bya ba yin/ rtags sna 'gag kha chu mi 'ong*/ drug pa bya rmugs zer/ rtags mthe bong sbed/ mig smad nas sbed/ bdun pa bya zer bu ngang zer/ rtags nu ma khar bcug nas ngu ba yin/

brgyad pa spu can zer rtags gong bzhin no// dgu pa bya dur nag po zer/ rtags ni skra ser/ nyin ngu*/ mtshan mtsher/ bcu pa bya tri ku ma/ bcu gcig pa bya dur bya/ bcu gnyis pa bya sha zan/ rtags brang gzhi na/ lag pa g.yas su thig le sngon po yong*/ res 'khru res skyugs/ bcu gsum pa las mkhan dgu las bya tri shan nag po/ byi dor nag po/ khram gdan nag po/ rtags ngo gdong la g.ya' chags/ rtsa phyir 'thon/ sha nang du bros/ bco lnga pa bya drigs pa lug phur/ gdung pa dang*/ rtags brang rdul/ tsha ba res skye/ bcu dgu pa bya gser bya du ma bya ba dang*/ g.yu bya mtshul ma rkang bya/ rtags sen mo mi grugs/ sha sngo nag tu 'ong*/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa phas bzung na stod nas/ mas bzung na smad nas/ bus bzung na rked nas rtags gong dang 'dra/ nad tsha grang*/ rlung bad kan dang 'brel tshul ni/ stod la thig le dmar po/ blo chung yod na tshad pa/ smad na thig le sngon po/ chu log nas 'o mar 'ong na grang ba/ lus sbo// lto stod la sha mtshan snang la sha mtshan/ zas log na rlung*/ lus skrangs/ chu bsri/ mchin pa na/ snying ga sogs la sha mtshan thig le byung na nad bad kan no// ma'i rum nas bzung na mur gong nas skra gcig phyis la bltas pas/ lha ba mer na rum nas bzung ba yin no// sos mi sos brtag pa ni/ skye dus kha sbub tu byung na mi sos/ dri mi zhim pa byung na mi sos/ rkang mthil du sme ba nag po byung na mi sos/ 'dzar 'dzer mang na mi sos/ spyir lus chag tshad dang mi ldan na mi sos/ skyon de rnams med na man ngag bsten par bya'o// gso ba la rten 'brel rdzas kyis gso ba/ nus pa sngags kyis gso ba/ rig pa ye shes kyis gso ba'o// dang po la gu gul/ gi'u waṃ/ gla rtsi gsum rkan mar la bsre/ mi khyi rta gsum gyi dri chen/ sug pa bsregs pa'i thal ba gsum mtshog skud la bsre/ spyir sman la/ gu gul/ mu zi/ gla ba/

dri chen/ khyi lud/ phag brun/ thar nu/ dbyi mong*/ re lcag mkhan pa/ sbru rtsa/ gi'u waṃ/ shing kun/ shu dag yung ba/ skyer pa/ bul tog rnams la khyung sngags kyi chus sbrus pa'i ril bu ma bu gnyis ka la btags par bya'o// ma byung bar du bcang ba'i rdzas la/ skye ga srin bya/ 'ug pa/ byi la/ sre mong*/ khyi nag rma bya/ zer mo/ mchil pa/ phag brun rnams so// shin tu gsang ba'i rdzas lags so// blon po gsum sbyor dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i gser yungs kar ma nyams pa/ sgong rang po khong srung du bang mdzod bya'o// skye ga'i gso ba/ byi la'i gso ba/ sre mong gi gso ba rnams la srog snying dang ling ga bcug la sgo ltag tu bcang bar bya'o// gnyis pa nus pa sngags kyis gso ba la/ rang khyung gi mngon rtogs bzhin du rtsa sngags bzlas/ sngags chu'am/ mar gang rung la/ mchil ma khyung gi tshogs nad rigs dang bstun/ ril bu ri rab sman ril bu rdzas khyung sgrub byed pa rnams zhal las shes so/ tsam gyi khyung*// bstims te khong du gtang bar bya// bu dang rang gi lus bsres la// bsnyen pa mang du bskyal bar bya// sngags rdeg dus su man ngag ni// stod nas bzung na smad nas brdeg /smad nas bzung na stod nas brdeg /sked nas bzung na 'ub kyis bsdu// rgyun du rang gi gshog 'dabs bcug /de nas rang gi man ngag gi gnad che'o// dang po btsan po'i mkhar du bcug pa ni dbang bskur/ /de nas khang phyi 'obs kyis bskor/ ba ni las bcol/ /res 'ga' mgyogs pa'i rta la bskyon/ pa ni drag las/ /bar du bsnun pa'i lcags gis brab/ pa ni sngags thun brdeg /de nas drag po'i dmag dpung bskyed/ pa ni dam can bskul la dgra bgegs bskrad/ /de nas las kyi go cha bskon/ pa ni sgrib shing*/ /bar du brngan pa byas la bskrad/ pa ni mdos dang glud/ /mjug tu nags rnams me la bsregs/

pa ni las tshogs me la bsreg /nus pa sngags kyi khyad par yin// rdo rje khyung gi sngags la pak+ṣiṃ/ ni// skabs su srog sngags 'di rnams sngags ni/ bya tsag tsag tsig tsig tsug tsug /nan nan swā hā/ nag po tsiṣ+ṭa rbud rbud/ sa dur rbad/ tsa dur rbad/ tsakra rbad/ yang gcig la/ nag po tsiṣ+ṭa rbud rbud sa du sa du tsakra rbad dza tsig tsig tsug tsug nan nan swā hā/ zhes so/ btags/ bya srung ba la gri lcags ral gri kha sbags pa sngas su bzhag sngags nyer gcig bya/ /bya btson du bzung ba ni/ 'di la skye ga'i gzugs drug byas la/ tshon skud sngon dmar gyis rke bcing*/ gtsug tor dkar mo'i snying po dang*/ tad+ya thāṃ/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ bishud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ sauṃ me sauṃ me/ badz+ra dhā ra ṇi bhan+dha bhan+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ phaṭa phaṭa/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dang*/ rbad gsum sngags rke la btags la phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga sgo ltag dang drug tu gdags so// bya skrog pa ni/ tshon sku lnga'i 'ur rdo la/ yugs sa mo'i sgyed rdo/ dor rta/ lcags phye/ dug khrag rnams kyang rdo zur gsum byas nas bya tshang du 'jug dus su rbad gsum gyi sngags bzlas shing mthongs kha'i phyogs bzhir brdeg go /bya spur ba ni/ ra dmar gyi sog pa ma 'byor na ra gang yin/ gnyis la rbad gsum gyi sngags dris la tshon skud kyis sbrel la rlung gis skrog tu bcug go /bya spur cho ga ni/ rang nyid khyung gi dmigs pa gsal bas/ bden pa bdar nas sngags gul bsreg a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ /bye ma rags pa yungs kar la// gong du rtsa sngags mang bzlas nas// nad pa'i snying gar brab par bya// yid kyi ngang nas man ngag bzhin// gdon de 'thon par the tshom med// 'byung bzhi'i nad rigs gang yin kyang*// 'di yis nges par grol bar 'gyur// de la khyung gi bya srung bya// tshon skud lnga la khyung lngar bskyed// sngags bden bdar la mgul du btags// rgyas par byed na srung 'khor ni// dbus su khyung snying ming dang ni// bya gdon 'di la rak+ṣa dris// rtsibs bzhir khyung rigs bzhi yi sngags// de yi mu khyud phyi ma la// bya yi srog sngags

rgyas par nyi shu rtsa gcig bri bar bya// de yi mu khyud phyi ma la// dbyangs dang gsal byed bri bar bya// rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris bskor// khyung khrar bskyed la rab gnas bya// 'bral med btags na phyis mi 'jug /rdzas ni mi khyi phag gsum gyi dri chen/ bong nga nag po/ gu gul/ byang ba nag po/ sbal nag ti tsha/ rdo pha wang*/ yung ba/ skyer pa/ bul tog ba bla/ mu zi/ sgog skya/ mkhan pa/ lang thang*/ spru rtsa/ dbyi mong*/ stag sha phur mong*/ sbrul sha khyi gu mig ma bye ba'i brun/ rta bon/ gser mu zi/ mu zi nag po/ khyi'i mje/ nal bu'i sha mngal khrag srin bya/ 'ug pa/ skya ga pho rog mchil pa/ nya/ sram/ phag pa/ khyi nag rnams kyi sha re lcags/ thar nu/ rdo dreg dkar dmar ser gsum/ mtshur rnams bsres pa'i byug pa bya'o// ske la 'dogs pa tshig chog man ngag sreg na zhal shes gcig dgos/ med na lha dbye ru 'gro gsungs/ lags so// gsum pa rig pa ye shes kyis gso ba ni/ sems la rnam rtog ci byung yang*// rnam rtog de ka chos nyid yin// chos nyid logs su bsgom mi dgos// bdud nyid sangs rgyas ngo shes na// bar chad rkyen dbang mi 'gyur ro// 'di la nan tan byed do sngags pa rnams// 'dre dang nad pa rang gi sems// gsal stong zung 'jug ngang la zhog /des ni bgegs nad rang sar grol// gsum pa phyi 'phro bcad pa la/ log rtog sgrib shing dang*/ tshims par byed pa bya mdos so// dang po ni// gzugs mo byi thur rma bya'i sgro// khwa ta'i sgro dang sbal pa'i sha /kyung ka'i sgro dang khwa ta'i khrag /byi ba'i mig dang tsan+dan dkar// shu dag gu gul nag po'o// 'di bcu u bha'i nang blugs te// 'bral med btags na gdon rnams thub// khyad par gsang ba'i sgrib shing ni// rgyal po dag la rta dkar snying*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i gdon lnga'i sgrib shing ni gzhan gces btus nang du gsal/ nas shes so// sngags kyi sgrib shing ni/

a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ zhes pa rtsa sngags sham bur btags// nus pa'i sngags 'di gdon la 'gro// ma yi rum du zhugs dogs na// gzug mo rma bya khwa ta dang*// sbal pa'i sha'am khrag kyang rung*// dur bya'i sha dang dong ga drug /ma skyes bar du ma la gdags// skyes nas bu la gdags par bya// yang sgrib shing gcig la/ rang khyung du bsgom/ khrus byed na sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chus khrus dang byab srung dang*/ sngags dri bzang gis maṇ+ḍal la/ bris la lhar bskyed/ lha tshogs khong du gzhug sbyin pa ni gcig go /sbyin sreg gi lag len zur du shes/ gnyis pa bya mdos btang ba ni zur du bri bar bya/ bsngo ba spyi dang mthun/ bya yi bsrung bsdom la/ bya sha/ bya sgong*/ bya'i lhag ma rnams spang*/ sha dmar/ rdzas dmar/ mgar tshang rnams su 'gro ba spang*/ gos dmar gsar pa yang spang*/ ma bu gnyis kar/ zhang po ma sru'i 'grul sna 'dzem// lo dus nas 'gror ma 'dod na/ spur chog dang sri'u sgrog 'grol gyi man ngag la brtson par bya'o// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga'i nang nas bya khu tshur can gyi bcos thabs/ gdon rnams rang sar grol byed ces bya ba/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung bzhin du rnal 'byor pa gzungs kyi ming can gyis sbyar/ de'i snying po zhal shes man ngag go bde'i phyir/ shrī bsam rtser bzang po'i ming can gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rdo rje khyung gi las mtha' bya mdos bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/ tshims par byed pa bya mdos kyi sog la/ rgyal po la nam mkha' gzha' ris gsum/ blon po la nam mkha' khrag mig gsum/ phyag tshang ba la nam mkha' g.yu mig gsum/ so pa la nam mkha' dmar po lcags mig gsum/ las mkhan la nam mkha' nag po khrag mig dgu/ klu la rgyang bu nyer gcig rnams bya'o// ri rab bang rim gsum pa bya/ bang rim dang po la rgyal rta'i rmig pa'i thog tu bya gzugs nyer gcig bang rim gsum la khyab par bya/

blon/ bar pa la phyag tshang pa dang so pa/ tha ma las mkhan rnams zer/ rgyang bus kyang kun khyab par bya'o// ri rab steng du bya'i gzugs gcig bzhag go /bya khyung gsum ste bya bzhir bya/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gzugs sbal pa lcong mo rnams kyi gzugs/ dkar gtor gsum/ mi'u thung gsum/ ngar glud gsum/ stag pa la bu chung gis zla ba du lon gyi khrom/ bu mo la glang ma la khrom bya'o// bshos bu dmar nag dgu bya/ de nas cho ga bstan te/ kyai/ 'phrul gyi gser bya gsum po 'di// gnas ni ri rab rtse na gnas// 'phyo ni dgung sngon mthon po'i dbyings na 'phyo// gser bya gser 'phru gser mig can// gser bya 'phrul gyi zangs gshog can// gser bya 'phrul gyi lcags sder can// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// mi ma yin gyi sprul pa ste// nam mkha' gzha' ris gsum dang ni// gser bya ser po gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*/ kyai/ ri rab chen po'i bum pa la// dngul bya dkar po gsum// gnas ni ri rab bum par gnas// 'phyo ni nam mkha'i mthong la 'phyo// dngul bya dngul 'phru dngul mig can// dngul bya 'phrul gyi g.yu gshog can// dngul bya 'phrul gyi zangs sder can// mi ma yin gyi sprul pa ste// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// nam mkha' dkar po khrag mig gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*/ dngul bya dkar po gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*/ kyai/ ri rab de yi kha khyer la// g.yu bya sngon po gsum// gnas ni ri rab rked la gnas// lding ni bar snang mkha' la lding*// g.yu bya 'phrul gyi g.yu mig can// g.yu bya 'phrul gyi g.yu gshog can// g.yu bya 'phrul gyi g.yu sder can// mi ma yin gyi sprul pa ste// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// nam mkha' ser po g.yu mig gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*// g.yu bya sngon po gsum gyis thugs dam bskang*// bskang yang bskang ste bzhes su gsol/

kyai/ ri rab chen po'i bang rim bar pa la// gzi bya khra bo gsum// gnas ni bang rim bar na gnas// 'phyo ni gling bzhi gling phran brgyad du 'phyo// gzi bya 'phrul gyi gzi mig can// gzi bya 'phrul gyi dung gshog can// gzi bya 'phrul gyi lcags sder can// snang srid kun gyi sprul pa ste// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// bskang yang bskang ste bzhes su gsol/ kyai/ ri rab chen po'i mu khyud la// lcags bya nag po dgu// gnas ni ri rab chen po'i mu khyud la// 'phyo ni phyogs bzhi kun tu 'phyo// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// lcags bya dgu yis thugs dam bskang*// gnod sbyin bgegs kyi sprul pa ste// khrag mig dmar po khyi li li// lcags mchu nag po tangs se tang*// lcags kyi sder mo zangs se zang*// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// nam mkha' khrag mig dgu yis thugs dam bskang*// bya nag chen po dgu yis thugs dam bskang*// sprul pa chen po dgu yis thugs dam bskang*// bskang yang bskang ste bzhes su gsol// rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du 'bul/ kyai/ nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre rnams/ hūm̐/ nga ni srid la bskos pa'i sngags pa ste// khyed ni srid la bskos pa'i lha 'dre yin// nga yi bka' la nyon cig lha 'dre rnams// kyai/ sa bdag rigs su gyur pa la// sa bdag klu bdud mgo dgu pa// gnas ni ri rab zom la gnas// gos su rgyang bu khra bo gyon// zas su dkar gsum mngar gsum za// g.yas pa lo thog 'joms pa'i zor ba 'dzin// g.yon pa nad kyi rkyal pa khyer// sems can mi la ma 'tshe cig /gdug pa klu yi sprul pa ste// ri rab zom la gnas bcas shing*// rgyu ni rgya mtsho'i gting du rgyu// sde brgyad chen po'i sprul pa ste// sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// rgyang bu nyer gcig thugs dam bskang*// gzugs brnyan tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// bskang yang bskang ngo bzhes su gsol// glud bsngo ba ni/

kyai/ dang po glud byung gang nas byung*// glud 'di mi mo spun dgu'i lag nas byung*// mi mo spun dgu'i glud du rkang bya 'theng po btang*// ngar glud 'di la 'byung ba sna lnga tshang*// ngar mi 'di la rten 'brel bcu gnyis tshang*// ngar mi 'di la khams chen bco brgyad tshang*// ngar mi 'di la dbang po sgo lnga tshang*// ngar mi 'di la don snying rnam lnga tshang*// ngar mi 'di la rgyu long snod drug tshang*// ngar mi 'di la rnam shes tshogs brgyad tshang*// kyai/ ngar mi 'di la rnam shes gzhan pas bkra// da ring ngar glud gnyan po 'di// sbyin bdag bu chung glud du 'bul// mi glud 'di dga' dang ya la la// bya tshang 'di skyid de 'bol lo lo// rdzas kyang kha gro thibs si thib// de phyir mi bas glud dga' 'o// bu chung glud du ngar mi 'bul// kyai/ sems can mi yi steng na ya bdud rgyal po che// de ring bshos bzang ldem pa dgu// glud du 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// bdud kyi khrom kha phyis/ btsan gyi sho rdel gtor/ bya bdud nag po rnams/ glud bdag glud bzhes shig mdos dag mdos longs shig ces brjod/ rang khyung khra'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas rtsa sngags bzla'o// dmigs pa 'jur nges byas la mtshams bcad do// tshims byed bya mdos kyi khrigs so// bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya'o// bya rgyud dang mthun par rdo rje khyung khra'i las mtha' gzungs pa'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i las tshogs las/ ngan song sgo 'gegs pa khyi smyon bcos thabs bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/ rdo rje khyung khra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyi smyon gyis so ma btab kyang dug babs pa dang*/ rma byung yang dug ma babs pa sogs mang bas/ mche ba'i dug ni bar snang glog dang 'dra// yud tsam thang re la yang mang po 'byung*/

rgyud las/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rus pa dang thug pa la'ang*// ma rgyus na mi lto ste/ de la gdon sha za smyo byed/ rigs ni thu ba spre'u kha 'tham/ nag chung kun 'bring*/ tu rgyu/ dmar ru rang tsam khrag ldag dang gsum yin/ gdon 'di ma grol na/ nad 'dis shi ba rnams ngan song du skye nges pas/ nad pa gzhan gsos pa las/ 'di phan yon che ste/ brgya rgyud las/ dang gcig ni gdon gyi khyad par che// 'di yi man ngag nyin mo'i skar ma 'dra// zhes gsungs/ 'di la dang po brtag thabs kyis yin min 'khrun bcad pa/ bar du gso byed kyi man ngag gis 'khren med du bcos pa/ tha ma rjes bcad kyis lo dus nas kyang mi ldangs pa'i gdams pa bstan pa'o// dang po brtag pa ni/ khron chu la bstan pas nad pa'i bzhin 'gyur ba'am/ thu na khyi'i gdong 'char bar snang ba dang*/ lce ring ba dang*/ khyi gdong du 'char ba dang*/ me long la yang de lta bu dang*/ has btab pas rang phyogs su 'dus na dug med pa'i rtags yin/ phyi la 'dus na dug yod/ chu me long dang nyi zer la blta'o// mkhar rdo srin med me la bsregs pa dmar hu re ba de la mchil ma btab pas nag por song na dug yod/ ma song na dug med/ gser me la bsregs pa rma la glan pas nag por song na dug yod/ dri chu dron mo la rma bya'i sgro bcug pas mdongs mer du song na dug yod/ ri bong gson po'i sma ra khar bcug pas gug na dug yod/ dug med na mi gug khyi smyon gyi mche ba nas tsam bdun lcags snod du me la ser tsam pa bsregs pa dang*/ dud pa bya bal ma/ yugs sa ma'i skrad pa bsregs pa'i gzhob/ rdo pha wang*/ de rnams thun gcig gnyis nus can gyi chus sprus pa btang bas/ lus sbrid pa/ gtse ba/ 'dar ba/ dngangs pa/ g.yal ba/ sbrid pa/ kha chu mig chu sogs mang ba/ dgod pa/ ngu ba/ mdor na gshis 'gyur ba sogs 'dug na/ dug babs nges pas/ phyis brtag long med/

de 'phral la bcos par bya'o// dug med na ci yang mi yong*/ rma la brtag pa ni/ rma gzhan las dmar ba/ nag pa/ rma kha phyir log pa/ nang du 'dus pa/ gtse zhing tsha ba de rnams byung na yod nges so// rma med pa la brtag pa ni/ chus bkrus pas chu mi chags/ steng na dmar nag rta rnga 'dra ba breng nge 'dug na dug bab/ khyi'i spu rigs la brtag pa ni/ khyi dkar po ni rgyal po/ nag po ni bdud/ dmar po ni gri bo/ ser po sogs ni btsan dang sde brgyad yin no// spre'u kha 'tham gsum du shes par bya'o// rmugs pa'i dus su brtag pa ni/ tho rengs nas nyin phyed yan rgyal po/ dgong ka bdud/ srod sogs btsan sde brgyad sogs yin/ shas gang che ba'i rim gro dang bcos ka bya/ gtsug tor dkar mo dang*/ sha za'i mdos bya'o// nad pa'i gshis 'gyur ba la brtag pa ni/ sngar gshis 'bol ba gyong ba/ gyong pa 'bol ba sogs dang phyi bshol che ba/ blo 'gyur ba/ snying mi dga' ba/ shes pa 'phyo ba/ rmi lam du khyi dang bud med yong ba/ srin po dang lhan cig tu bsdad pa/ bud med yin na bag la 'gro ba/ skyes pa la btson du bzung ba/ de rnams byung na gdon gyis bzung ba'i rtags yin no// gza' skar nyi ma bzang ba la rmugs na gso sla/ ngan pa la gso dka'o// de ni be'u chung lta bu las shes so// khyi smyo ba'i rtags ni/ zhag lnga tsam lto mi ldag pa dang*/ 'khyams pa dang*/ lce nar ba dang*/ kha chu dang*/ gzugs la za ba dang*/ bdag po la 'dzem pa dang*/ mi dga' ba sogs 'ong*/ dus ni gong dang 'dra'o// langs ma thag gi mche rgod shin tu gnyan no// gnyis gsum la rmugs nas mchi dug yal ba yang lta reg dri ba rnam gsum gyis brtag pa la/ blta ba chu/ reg pa rtsa/ dri ba gong bzhin no// 'dir dri ba gtso che/ nad gang gi steng du babs/ gdon ngos bzung ba sogs rgyas par gzhung gi rtsa mdo chu mdor gsal bas der blta bar bya'o// bla ma'i gsungs so//

yod/ bar du gso dpyad man ngag gis bcos pa ni/ rma byung na dri bzang gi chus rgyun ring du bkru/ gangs chu brin/ de rjes rma la dom mkhris cha tsam zhig btab/ rma nad ltar tshas dang gso thabs bya/ sngags srog sngags dang*/ khyung gi sngags brgya rtsa rma kha la btab bo// zhag bdun kha mi 'byed do// rma med yin na/ nad kyi mgo mnan pa la/ rta sreb sngon po'i sbangs kyi khu ba mar khus phul/ lto stong la btang ba man ngag gcig go /bzang drug gla ba/ gu gul/ shu dag nag po/ gi'u waṃ/ rdo pha wang*/ khyi smyon ngo bo ma rnyed na gzhan gyi snying*/ gyi snying gi rtse mo rnams ril bu byas pa zhag mang du btang ba gcig go /'brug gi lte 'og rang 'thag gis/ stag gi mjug ma'i sgo 'og gis/ gnam gyi ral dud pa pa'i sa de rnams thang du btang ba gcig go /gso dpyad kyi sman la/ spyir gnyan sbyong gcig dgos/ ma byas na nad mkhris che bas gso ba dka'/ de la man ngag zab pa mang du gsungs kyang*/ nā ro pa nas bar ma chad pa'i zhal shes ni/ gi'u waṃ gzhu la pa ti mda'// 'phen byed dpa' bo dkar po yin// myur du 'big 'dod gang rung ste/ dur byid/ /sgyel 'dod sbrul sha btang ba yin// 'gro lugs sdod lugs zhal shes rnams// rgyus can gsang ba'i mi la bla ma/ a ru ra/ dza ti/ snying zho sha /cu gang*/ ru rta/ dris// de'i rjes su a kar brgyad kyi steng du gser mdog ge sar/ spos dkar/ la cha mes ma bsreg pa phyed/ ka ra drug 'gyur gyi sman/ gangs g.ya' chu/ gangs chu/ rdza chu gsum gang rung*/ chu'am/ rlung shas che na sing pos phul la gtang*/ zhag re thun re gtong ba mchog yin no// des rlung mi skye tshad pa chog pa yin no// yang bshal ni/ dngul chu zho gang*/ mu zi zho do/ 'bras bu gsum po/ re re'ang zho gsum/ rog dan+da po zho drug bya ba yin/ shin tu zab/ yang na/

ka mo thar nu nya la dug gi nang bzhin bya ba gcig yin no// snying shugs che na ltag tsa'i spu 'khyil dang*/ rgyab kyi bdun pa/ mdun gyi dkar nag gi mtshams bsreg phal che ba la me spar/ nad rlung tshad 'thabs pa la skyo tsha mar dang bku mnye/ chu rdo me la bsros la phying pa snum can la dril la gang na sar dugs bya/ nus pa sngags kyis bcos pa ni/ khyung bsnyen bskyal/ nyin re la srog sngags 'di gsum bsnyen pa'i gsham du brgya rtsa re bzlas so// sngags ni/ kha dug shrī rbad/ nā ga shrī rbad/ du ga na shrī rbad/ ces lo dus bar bskyal lo// khyung bsnyen 'bru 'bum bskyal na gdon las grol nges so// spang bya la/ chang lo ru bsrung*/ mya ngan dang*/ mi snyan pa'i gtam rnams spang ngo*// khyis rmugs bsam pa mi bya/ khyi'i gtam mi bya/ 'thabs mo byed sar mi 'gro/ bag phebs pa'i gtam dang*/ snyan pa'i tshig brjod/ rang gi bzhin 'char ba'i rdzas rnams la mi lta/ blo mthun pa'i mis g.yog bya'o// de rnams kyis ma grol ba'am/ 'jings che ba dang*/ rtags rnams ye ma 'gyur na/ rtsa lto'i bshal bya ste/ gong gi man ngag gi steng du gegs sel gzer lnga'i man ngag rnams bya'o/ 'dir mkhas pa brang ti pa'i ser mo'i sman dpyad byas na legs so/ /des thub nges so// khyi skad thos kyang sos pas man ngag zab lags so// rnal 'byor ba'i rang srung ni/ gu gul nag po/ gla rtsi/ 'ug pa'i sgro gzhob/ khong du bang mdzod bya/ nad pa la reg pa'i dus nad pa'i kha phye rkyal gyis bkab nas byas pas/ rang la dug rlung mi 'ong ba lags/ khyad par rdo rje khyung khra'i bsnyen sgrub song nas dug gi dogs pa bya mi dgos/ rang byang sems dang ldan pas sman dpyad byed pa gal che'o// tha ma rjes bcad pa ni/ a kar brgyad pa'i sman dang ra thug lug thug gi rwa rtse'i gzhob/ sreb kyi rta bon po/ yugs sa'i skra gzhob/ khyi smyon gyi mjug rtse'i gzhob rnams sla nga ru ga pur nag po bzo ba bzhin bya/

de'i thal ba mar la sbyar la/ lto stong la thengs 'ga' re btang*/ des mi bzlog go /srung bas rjes bcad pa dang*/ rang srung ba la gro ga'am/ ras sam shing shun la rab gser la sogs pas mu khyud phyi ma la me ri/ rdo rwa/ de'i nang ma la dbyangs gsal/ de'i nang ma la rtsibs bzhi la khyung rigs bzhi'i sngags/ mtshams su mu khyud la sha za'i srog sngags/ dbus su khyung khra'i snying po dang*/ 'chang ba po ming 'di zhes bya ba la sha za smyo byed kyi gdon las srungs shig rak+ṣa/ zhes bri'o// srung skud sngags la khyung rigs lngar bskyed pa yang gcig go /sgrib shing ni/ spyir bya dang mtshungs shing*/ 'di rang la 'ug sgro/ dur bya/ rma bya gsum yang gcig yin no// khyi dug ni dus phyis man ngag dang mthun yang gdon nad gtso che bar bcas pa lags so// khyi smyon gso ba'i man ngag sngags par rlom pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyi phyir du/ sa skya gong ma'i yig cha dang mthun par rnal 'byor pa gzungs pa'i ming can gyis sbyar/ de'i snying po zhal shes man ngag rnams go bde ba'i phyir shrī bsam rtser bzang po'i ming can gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i las sbyor las/ gdon las rnam grol bzhugs so// rdo rje khyung khra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// gza' bcos sems can don la brtsams pa la/ de la dang po brtag pa/ bar du gso dpyad/ phyir mi ldog pa rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la nor gyis dogs pa'i 'phrang gnyis te/ dmu dang nor ba/ rlung nad dang nor ba/ gzhan yang dug nad dang nor ba sogs mang bas/ khyad par gyi rtags ni/ dus ni bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu gcig dang*/ bco brgyad nyi shu gnyis dang lnga/ nyer dgu bco lnga mche ba'i go rim bzhin/ nad rtags/ rgyal po gzer grib kha rlung lnga/ rgyas bab 'chi babs phyed ma gsum 'tsho gsungs so// zi 'thoms pa/ 'gyel ba/ kha mig 'chus pa/ grib ma/

sha 'gul 'phrigs pa/ dri chu bsdams pa/ skyugs pa/ lag pa sogs zha ba/ rengs pa/ gyong ba/ lkugs pa/ ngu ba/ smyo ba/ 'bog pa/ dran pa nyams pa/ bred pa 'dra ba/ 'dar ba dang*/ dngangs pa 'byung ngo*// nang rtags la/ rtsa bying grims/ rtsa ni ma nges ci yang ston// de yang phal cher rlung tshad 'dra// mnan na gting lhod kha na grim// skabs su sdod cing 'phar 'gul byed/ ces rgyud las gsungs so/ mig gi rgyal mo 'dar ba/ mig mig sprin dung gi gzhal yas la// khyab 'jug 'khor lo babs ma babs// rgyal mo 'phel 'grib byed mi byed/ btsan gyi zhags pa btab ma btab// mkhas pas nyams su blang bar bya// zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ gi rtsa ris steng 'og bar gsum du bya dang 'dra ba'i ri mo thig le sogs 'byung ngo*// mdangs gsal yod la dkar ba bzang ngo*// sna rtse la yang sngo dmar me chu dag dang sbyar la/ lce la ring thung byas pa dang*/ sen mo g.yu ral mes tshigs pa ral pa 'dra ba yod/ 'dra ba/ de rnams me gza' g.yas/ chu gza' g.yon/ de la gnas pa'i gzhi rtsa khams bag chags kyi tshul du gnas/ 'byung ba'i rgyu ma rig pa/ rkyen rnam rtog dang lha 'dres byed/ 'bras bu nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yin/ gnyis pa bcos thabs la/ bcos su mi rung ba'i rtags 'di rnams med na bcos par bya'o// rtags ni/ mig gi rgyal mo 'dar ba dang*// so 'thoms sdangs zhing zug gzer che// skyugs pa lhud byung zhag lnga 'das/ /nyer dgu la bzung ba rnams /phal cher 'chi bas spangs bar bya// mes ma bsdam par 'bog pa ni// gso ba dka' yang skyon chung yin// babs steng lus kyi steng du babs pa/ me byas spang bar rigs// gnyis pa gso ba la/ rten 'brel rdzas dang nus pa sngags kyis gso ba'o// bdug pa'i dri rdzas la gu gul dkar nag gis bdug ste/ nad pa'i bu ga dgu po nas/ me gza' la sna bug g.yas nas dkar po/ chu gza' la sna bug g.yon nas nag po/

chu la spos dkar dud pa spang*/ byer 'gro/ gos la snum shor dpe dang 'dra/ gza' btson du 'dzin pa la gdon gang yin gyi ming dang srog sngags/ ti pa rtsi'i gzugs su bzung la bsgom bya byas nas sgo ltag tu bcang bar bya'o// sman gyis bzung ba ni zhal las shes/ de nas spos dkar grang thang dang*// spos nag bskol ba'i dro thang gnyis// bsregs pa bya ral can bsres la// rim pa bzhin du btang ba yis// gzhan du mi byer btson du 'dzin// ces rgyud nas gsungs/ gza' spur ba ni/ bye ma nyungs kar lcags phye dang*// ske tshe dag la sngags stong bzlas// khyung khra'i nga rgyal brtan po yis// snying khar sngags rdeg nad gdon rnams// rnag khrag dud khur bsams nas ni// dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu yi// bu ga nyid nas thon par bsam// rlung shas che na spyi bo nas// sngo bun du ba ltar du song*// bye ma sa la dbugs ni rlung*// mchil ma chu la dmigs pa me// sngags dang khyung dmigs bstun nas su// snying gar rdeg cing phaṭa drag brjod// nad gdon nyid las grol bar 'gyur// khrus dang byab srung bya ba dang*// bden brdar spur chog byas nas su// khyung khrar bskyed la bka' bsgo brjod// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la// hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nyid kyis ni// srung ba dam pa mchog tu 'gyur// snying gar reg go /'byung ba bzhi yi spur chog zab// chu la me dpyad me la chu dpyad bya'o// me dpyad 'di ni drag spur te// tsher ma'i shing la me byas la// byab srung sngon song me de nyid// me khyung bskyed la lan grangs bskor/ tshad ma sogs /me dang shes pa 'thib pa la/ g.ya' chu gangs chu sogs/ /chu dpyad byed tshe dro chu la/ gza' lcam sring lnga'i /rtsa sngags btab cing gzugs 'gros dang*// nad pa'i srin mdzub tshon skud sbrel/ dgra grogs /chu de nad 'joms khyung du bsgom// snying khar rdeg dus

lan gsum/ sgrim par gces/ drug bdun/ /spyi bo nas ni bkram par gces// stod kyi nad la gegs sel lo// tshon skud gris bcad gzugs rnams 'bul/ gtsang sar/ /nad rigs gang yin rigs bzhi'i khyung*// dgra grogs brtsis la dmigs pa phog rdzas ni zug gzer drag po skyes na/ gla rtsi tsan+dan dkar po/ ga pur nag po gangs chus phul/ chu 'gags na yung ba ser po dang rgya tshwa btang*/ spyi 'joms la rgya tshwa/ sman chen/ re ral/ spang spos/ gur gum/ shug tsher can/ de rnams 'khor bzhi la srang lnga/ gtso bo la srang gang*/ yang na ga bur nyer lnga gtang*/ ga bur/ dzā ti/ cu gang*/ ka ko la/ li shi/ gur gum/ gla sgang*/ pu shel tse/ suka smel/ spang spos/ rdo brag dmar po/ ba le ka tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ka ru nag po/ shing tsha/ shing kun/ zi ra/ ge sar/ ut+pal sngon po/ chu srin sder mo/ 'bu su hang*/ tsha ba gsum/ ka drug 'gyur ro// tshad khrag bad kan 'dres na/ sbyor ba 'di bzhin gang thengs kyang*// don la drang srong 'chor mi srid// sman 'dres khyer ba'i nad pa la// spyod skyugs rtsa bshal gang 'jug kyang*/ rtsa la dbye zhing sbyor ba'o// rgyud las gsungs so/

bshal gyi rim pa gzer lnga zhal shes kyi steng du/ gza' dug ser po nag po sngo gsum bsnan/ tshad stobs che na ga pur/ rlung la dzā ti'o// rus pa'i gting khrol na thang phrom pa'o// mi khyi rta gsum gyi rus pa/ sreb kyi sen mo 'bri mar la bsres te byug par bya'o// glo sman la a gar brgyad steng du/ spos dkar bzhi 'gyur gtang*/ gnon sman la spos dkar chung ngu 'jug spyir skar chus phul/ btung ba thams cad/ rlung shas che na sing pos yang na/ phul/ zha rengs la rang gi dri chu la/ lug ngal ba dang*/ ro sol bsres pas dugs bya'o// 'bog pa la dzā ti/ ra dug pa/ gzer 'joms ser po rnams zab pa'i yang zab lags/ srung ba dang sgrib shing med na bris pa sku'i 'khor lo/ bzlas pa sngags kyi 'khor lo/ bsgom pa thugs kyi 'khor lo/ nor bu yon tan gyi 'khor lo/ sna tshogs phrin las kyi 'khor lo/ sgrib shing*/ kha ma bcad pa'i bya tshang gi dpe 'dra/ phyis mi 'jug pa'i gdams pa bya ba ni/ sku'i 'khor lo ras sam shing shun la gser ram mtshal lam rgya snag gis/ rang lhar gsal/ smyu gu khyung gi sder mos bya/ rdo rje rwa ba me ri dang*// dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams kyis bskor// de yi nang gi mu khyud la// gza' brgyad ming la nan ces bri// mtshams su srog sngags 'di rnams bri// oṃ hri ma ma tri a su swā hā/ de yi nang gi mu khyud la// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir khyung rigs lnga// rtsibs mtshams rnams su srog sngags bri// dbus su ming dang gdon rnams las/ srungs shig rak+ṣa dang khyung gi rtsa sngags bri// btags grol gsang ba yongs rdzogs yin// srung skud lnga bsgril byed sna tshogs phrin las/ pa'ang gcig srung ba'i shubs ni nam mkha'i mdog /'di la dgos byed zhal las shes// skar gyi phra nor bu yon tan gyi men zhes bya ni// lig bu byung ba'i dwangs ma yin// mthong ba brgyud pa'i ngo sprod ces pa ni/

khyung khra'i bskyed chog byas pas rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ hriṃ ma tri 'di blo la yod pas thub/ a su swā hā/ ma la tshul khrims dag pa'i ngang la gza' yis gnang ba yin/ a ya ma pre dun te sha na/ gza' kha kra ru kra ye swā hā/ gser gyis bris pa dang*/ phra men sdeb pa yang mdzad/ phra men chig thub srung ba yin/ yang na sbrang bu yod pa'i spos shel gyis gnam gzer dang bya rnams bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// rdo rje khyung khrar bskyed la 'bral med btags/ tshims par byed pa gza' mdos gtang*/ yang na/ rang gzhan srung ba'i rdzas la gu gul nag po/ yugs sa mo khyo ga dang ma 'phrad pa'i dor rta/ phra men gyi pags pa lus la bcang ngo*// sngags ni/ oṃ a pa ra tsakra hri tri rā hu la a pa na ye swā hā/ drang srong khyod la rtog par mi 'gyur mod// na ba rkyen dang rnam rtog rang gi sems// dbyer med chen po'i ngang du bzhag par bya/ bzlas pa kun gyis/ /bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum bskyal na mi rabs gsum/ steng gdon 'og gdon mi 'byung rgyud las gsungs// 'di la mthun sa bdag zin phung brtsi ba dang mthun pa/ pa'i ming brgyad/ lus kyi dum bu brgyad/ tshes grangs brgyad/ dus tshod brgyad/ rgyu ba'i phyogs brgyad/ 'gro ba'i sa brgyad/ rang sar ldog pa'i dus brgyad sogs dang*/ phyi ru rten 'brel brtsi ba ni// drag lto 'phye hal khyi sgra gcan/ las byed pa la dgos te/ phyi ru rten 'brel ma brtsis na// mun pa'i dkyil rang la phog gam gzhan la phog pa/ na mda' rgyag 'dra// ces gsungs so// gsum pa rjes kyi dam tshig ni/ rta mi zhon/ nyi zla gzas bzung ba la mi lta/ bshul chags kyi sha mi bza'/ khrag tshod spang*/ rul sum rnying bag tsha skyur spang*/ rgyu phyogs su sngas mi ston/ zla ba gnyis su nag mo mi bsten/ rol mo/ g.yang sa/ tshig mi snyan pa/ me las/ ro las rgyas par 'dod pa dang rdzogs pa drang srong gsang ba snying gdams kyi rgyud du bltas pas mun khung du sgron me gsal ba ltar ro//

rnams spang ngo*// khyung khra'i man ngag las sbyor 'di// snyigs dus sngags par rlom pa rnams// yi dam lha yi nus mi thon// sems can phal cher gdon gyis khyer// de la sgrub pa khyung khra 'di myur bas// gong ma'i gsung sa skya gong ma'i rgyun ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor gzungs kyi dpal gyis sbyar// nga min gzhan la med snyam nga rgyal yod// 'di 'dra lha yi gtsug na nor dang mtshungs// gdon gyi bcos thabs zab zab 'dra na yang*// 'di med kha 'khyags za 'dod sdug ri kha// mi ngan gzhan la chig brgyud min par rdzogs par mi sbyin no/ ma spel bka' rgyas btab// rdzas sngags la sogs skabs na mi 'dug na/ rang rang gi bya khyi gnam gsum la sogs khongs su ltos/ las tshogs rnams/ /kha 'phangs zhal shes dbang thob dus su ston/ rjes gnang ma song par mi ston/ /ces gsungs pa'i don rnams lag len dkyus su go bde bar zhal shes kyis brgyan pa 'di shrī bsam rtser bha dra'i ming can gyis bris pa*// //rdo rje khyung khra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rang byung gi dkar phra men ni/ dkar nag dmar ser 'dres pa'i mig gis brgyan// ri mo mig nang ma 'khyogs pa// rab gsum 'bring gnyis tha ma gcig /sked dkris snying la la ril 'dra ba de// lig bu 'byung ba'i dwangs ma yin// u rgyan srin yul rnams nas 'byung*// ces gsungs so// rang byung 'di la phan yon lnga yod pas/ rgya yi bzos mas phan yon mi 'byung ngo*// zhal shes so// dge 'o// ༈ /gza' bcos le lag dang shog dril khyung rgya ma bzhugs so// na mo// mthun pa'i ming brgyad sogs ni/ ming ljang sngon dpung pa g.yon pa la ma mor sprul nas/ tshes bzhi'i srod la nub nas shar du rgyu/ dro gang ldog ming rā hu la lag pa g.yas dgra lhar sprul nas tshes brgyad kyi snga dro dang po la/ shar lho nas nub byang du 'gro/

srod la ldog ming rā dza ka chu so bdud du sprul nas/ tshes bcu gcig la nam nam phyed yol zhes pa'ang byung*/ gung byang nas lho ru rgyu/ nyin gung ldog ming baṣ+ṭi pa ṭa mgo bo srin por sprul nas/ tshes bco lnga la nyi ma phyed nas lho nub nas byang du byang shar snang*/ 'gro/ nam phyed la ldog ming ha li bi nu rā dza ka mjug ma dmu ru sprul nas/ tshes bco brgyad la nam phyed yol nam phyed/ nas/ shar nas nub tu 'gro/ nyi ma phyed la ldog ming du ba mjug ring lag g.yon gshin rjer sprul nas/ nyer gnyis la nyi ma phyed yol la nub byang nas shar lhor 'gro/ nam phyed yol ldog ming khyab 'jug dpung g.yas glu btsan du sprul nas/ nyer lnga'i skya rengs shar ba tsam la lho nas byang du 'gro/ nyi ma myur nas ldog ming sgra gcan 'dzin snying dang mchin pa rā hu lar sprul nas/ nyer dgu la nyi ma myur ba nas byang shar nas lho nub tu 'gro/ tho rengs ldog pha srin po tshes bcu gsum la rgya mtshor rgyu/ ma klu mo nyer gsum la nam mkhar rgyu/ spur chog byed dus dang*/ drag las rnams la gdong thug na rang la ldog cing 'khu/ kho gar 'gro'i phyogs su rang kha blta'o// hom sogs la zab/ res gza' bdun ni/ stag rta khyi gsum spen pas tshes// byi 'brug sbrel gsum zla ba mig dmar tshes// bya glang sbrul gsum phur bu tshes// yos lug phag gsum zla ba/ zla ba tshes// zhes dang*/ nyi ma me nag rtsis nang ltar/ dang zla ba chu// mig dmar me dang lhag pa chu// phur bu shing dang pa sangs lcags// spen pa sa yi khams su sbyar// zhes dang*/ pho drug nyi ma stag zla ba/ la tshes// mo drug nyi ma sprel zla ba la tshes// nya ba khyi 'brug gnyis la nya// stong pa glang lug gnyis la stong*// rang lo phyogs su drag las byed dus mi 'gro/ 'gro ba spang*// rang nyid de las

nyi ma de las mi bya/ drag po'i las// gza' dang thug par mi bya'o// phyi ru rten 'brel brtsi ba'i las bya rags par cha tsam yi ger bkod pa maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gza' brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ mai bholkā ya swā hā/ nyi ma/ dmar po nyi ma bsnams pa/ oṃ shi tāṃ sha be swā hā/ zla ba/ dkar po me tog kun da bsnams pa/ oṃ rak+ta aṃ ga ku ma rā ya swā hā/ mig dmar/ dmar po me thab/ oṃ bu dhā ya swā hā/ lhag pa/ ljang gu ut+pal bsnams pa/ oṃ bṛ haspa ta ye swā hā/ phur bu/ ser po pu sti bsnams pa/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ pa sangs/ dkar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇā ya swā hā/ spen pa/ nag po be con bsnams pa/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swā hā/ sgra gcan/ dmar nag bum pa bsnams pa/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be swā hā/ mjug ring sngags skor bris nas su// ming dang sbyar ba gang rung shis// rang srung khyad par gdams pa ni// bco lnga'i bsil zer dkyil 'khor lta// oṃ gtum po li gtum po li/ ting dhing so bhi/ so tong me me shig shig swā hā/ ga ru ṭa ā tsaṇ+ḍa/ brgya rtsa bzlas nas chu la bsngags// ri bong 'dzin pa de la gtor// zhal shes dkyus su bkod pa yin// khyung gi tshogs la bzod par gsol// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo rā hu la'i byad 'grol/ sla nga chu yis bkang ba'i nang du mgo dgu'i gzugs gcig la gdong mo bzhis bskor ba bzo/ ming rus sna rang gsal ba gsum ldan gyi gris ske bcad nas don snying 'don/ sngags mi bya/ yak+ṣi nyi ma la/phaṭ / dur shaṃ zla ba la/ se shaṃ phaṭa/ mig dmar la/ pho shaṃ phaṭa/ phur bu la/ pher spen pa la/ shaṃ phaṭa/ trag rā hu la la/ shaṃ phaṭa/ sla nga'i chu dang gzugs tsho snod gcig tu blugs la/ 'bab chu la bskyal nas sbyin bsreg nyin gcig bya/ rten gyi yul 'pho/ 'og tu bya/

ri 'gram dbang du 'gyur/ du bya/ thang dkyil mi gdug ra gsum/ du bya/ bzang rten nang 'brel/ rang dang 'gras pa'i rnam par snang*/ mi sogs lha 'dre dbang med thog tu byung na/ la bsngos btang ba/ bar du dbang du sdud pa rang gi tha ma rjes su bzung ba/ skong thabs byas nas/ 'tsheng ba gsum gyis sa la gnas par bya'o// byad 'grol ba mang yang*/ khyung dang 'brel ba'i las sbyor 'di la rā hu la'i bka' 'bangs bkol lo// g.yo sgyu zol zog can rnams la ma ston cig /rin chen gser gyis slu yang ma ston cig /zhal shes rnams ni gshin rje'i las sbyor 'dra// dpal nā ro pa'i gdams pa rdo rje khyung gi las sbyor rā hu la'i byad 'grol/ gzungs pa'i lag len sa skya rdzong chung bla brang du brjed byang yi ger bris pa dge'o// shog dril khyung rgya ma zhes bya ba sa chen gyis mdzad pa sa skyas mdzad pa'i gser chos yin nges pas snod min la mi ston no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /khyung gi las mtha' gshed skor zab mo bzhugs so// na mo/ de nas me chu gang babs kyi dpyad la/ khrus chog sogs bcos mang du bya'o// gza' bdud kyis zin pa sogs la 'byung ba gshed skor gyi man ngag ni/ oṃ thar oṃ thar ro mud med sod/ khyar khyer sha gya sod/ thog thog sbyib sod/ go chen go chen khyung ling ling 'chor ba sod// khas yang lhog rgod sod/ bram ze phaṭ kyis sod/ drang srong bsod kyis sod/ zer ba'ang snang*/ ro mun men sod/ thar thor sha gya sod/ thog thog sbyib sod/ go chen go chung sod/ ling ling 'chor ba sod/ khas yang lhog rgod sod/ bram ze phaṭa kyis sod/ drang srong sod kyis sod/ sngags so// rdzas ni ba dmar mo'i rna rgyab kyi spu la skud pa byas te/ sngags brgya rtsa btab la nad pa'i gong pa g.yas g.yon la btags/ sa nag po la sāts+tsha byas la nad pa'i spyi gtsug tu bzhag la/

sngags gong bzhin bya'o// lto bar sa nag po glan la sngags gong bzhin no// lcags phur bzhi me la bsregs te chu la bton te shar nas g.yas skor du bskor/ phyogs bzhir 'phang ngo*// nad pa rang gi gdong mi bstan no// klu gtor mang du bya'o// 'byung ba gshed skor ma 'di/ sha la babs pa min pa la mi bya'o// man ngag 'khor lo 'khon sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin rim par byon nas/ gzungs pa'i ming can la'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo/ sbrul lpags la mtshal gyi k+ṣiṃ bris la rab gnas bya/ rin po che lnga dang gla ba la sngags nyer gcig btab la/ de mgul du btags na klu dang gza' rigs thub gsungs pa'i man ngag dus 'khor ba'i lugs zab// / / ༈ /na mo/ ba tshā can dang dul ba dang*// lkugs dang btson chu dug chu spang*// gangs chu g.ya' chu rdza chu dang*// sa gzhi dkar la chu skyes bzang*// chu dpyad gangs chu bcud len rtag gtor sogs la chu bzang po btsal lo// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i las mtha' gza' mdos bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/ gza' mdos 'bring po'i sog la/ nam mkha' khong smug brgyad/ dbus su mthing nag gcig shar du mthing nag gcig lhor ser nag gcig nub tu dmar nag gcig byang du ljang nag gcig rgyang bu shar du sngo dkris drug lho ru ser dkris drug nub tu dmar dkris drug byang du ljang dkris drug mtshams bzhir ser dkris re re/ ri rab 'bru las byas pa'i steng du stod mi la smad sbrul du byas pa/ bya ti to la zhon pa/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du'ang*/ sbrul mjug can brgyad kyis bskor ba/ zhal phyag rnams ni gza' brgyad lta bu'o// bang rim gnyis pa la/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi ming gzugs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mtha' la bshos bu dgu/ gtor ma dgu/ chang skyogs dgu/ snang gsal/ mda'/ 'phang*/ ting lo/ rgyang bu rnams mthun/ gza' yum la yang de dang mthun no// de nas yi dam gyi phrin las gzhung bsrang*/

rim gnyis gsal bas 'di skad do// kyai/ dang po dmag dpon chen po dang*// gnam gyi bya ma gung rgyal gnyis// srid pa'i ri rab ngos la 'tshogs pa las// zhang po klu la mes po srin// srin po'i bu mo nal du song ba'i mi// bu ni tsha gang bya ba yin// sprul pa'i mi chung 'theb tsam ni// rta chung byi ba tsam la zhon nas sprul pa bkye// sred ni sha khrag dmar la sred// rgyu ni zla gcig dus brgyad rgyu// mchod ni ding ma rnams kyis mchod// gza' bdud se gnyan rog po ni// sku mdog sngon po stong bzhin la// zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste// dbang po su 'phrad 'dzin pa'i gza'// g.yas na dar nag rgyal mtshan 'phyar// g.yon na sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin// sku mdog dmar nag 'od zer 'phro// chibs su byi rta sngon po chibs// 'khor ni lha 'dre sde bcus bskor// klu dang gza' skar bran du 'khol// rgyu ni bar snang steng 'og sogs// phyogs bcu kun tu rgyug cing rgyu// khyod ni thog ser bdag po yin// gdong dang grib ma su 'bab pa// zha dang rengs lkugs brgyal bar byed// khyed dang gang zhig su 'phrad pa// mi phyugs thams cad rlag par byed// khyed la sku glud 'bul ba ni// sha khrag rnam pa sna tshogs pa// dkar gsum mngar gsum rtsi sman dang*// sol ba'i mi nag mdung tsam dang*// bya ma ti to de la bskyon// nam mkha' khong smug dgu yis bskor// mda' dang rgyang bu dgu yis mtha' brten te// glud ni nyid dang mthun par 'bul// me chu dag gi glud 'di 'bul// bshos bu de ni zas kyi bcud// gser skyems phongs pa skom gyi gta'// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud// glud kyi dwangs ma 'di nyid ni// ngar glud 'di la phung po lnga yang tshang*// ngar glud 'di la khams chen bco brgyad tshang*// ngar glud 'di la dbang po sgo lnga tshang*// ngar glud 'di ni rnam shes gzhan las bkra// rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du 'bul// bzung ba thong la bcings pa khrol// gza' bdud gdug pa'i nad gzer thul// ri rab mdos su bcas pa 'bul// bdag nyid las thabs ci byed kyang*// nyams na ko long ma sdoms shig

/phrad na zar zer ma gtong zhig /phog dang kha rlangs slar sdus shig /sems can rnams la gnod tshe spong*// sbyin pa gsum gyis tshims par shog /ces mdos lho nub tu gtang ngo*// phyi mig mi blta'o// tshims par byed pa gza' mdos kyi cho ga las rnams kyi sngon du 'gro ba 'jig rten pa'i gza' la gza' rgyud dang mthun par glud mdos kyi cho ga 'bring po rdzogs so// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i dug gso ba'i man ngag bzhugs so// rdo rje khyung khra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dug bcos pa'i man ngag bai ḍūr+ya'i phreng ba bstan no// de la dang po brtag thabs/ gnyis pa bcos thabs/ gsum pa rjes bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po mtshan nyid dang man ngag gis brtag thabs so// dang po kha zas rnam pa lnga/ gang las byung*/ dbang po lnga la brtag par bya'o// chang la btab na

lta na tsha mi gsal/ mig la'o// sha'am snum la btab na sna dri mi tshor bar dgag la'o// dkar la btab na lce ro mi tshor bar dgag la'o// rtsam par btab na rna ba mi thos par dgag la'o// spyir gang la btab kyang pho mtshan mi ldang ngo*// so la'ang spyir 'ong*/ mtshan nyid kha cig ni mod la btsan dug 'phral du blud pa dang 'dra ste/ mdze la pho log glang thabs su gnas/ lce phugs su 'bros/ lce gug hril du 'gro/ mchu dang rnyil nag por 'gro/ mkhur tshos dang mig gi kri ga nag por 'gro/ glo snying dang rgyu ma gtubs snyam byed/ pho mcher kun kyang gtubs snyam byed/ rtsa dang sha gseb na srin rgyug par snyam pa byed pa dang*/ gris gshags pa 'dra ba ste rtags 'di lta bu ni/ btsan dug dang log dug 'phral du byin pa'o// dug thams cad na lugs 'di ltar 'ong*/ btsan dug 'phral du 'ong ba dang*/ lud pa la ske 'gags pa yong*/ sha dug rims thabs su na/ khyad par mgo dang rus pa na/ khyi dug gzhan du go/ lo dug 'phral du ma smin pa ni/ ci ste 'tsho dka' ba lags/ gong gi rtags rnams kyi steng du/ rims drag po rnams kyi na lugs bzhin du/ rus pa'i khongs la lus khyad par du tsha ba yin no// de rnams na lugs kyi mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa man ngag gi brtag thabs ni/ rin po che'am rgya phor dri ma med pa'i nang du chu gtsang blugs te/ lto stong gi mchil ma blugs pas/ gting du phyin pa 'ja' tshon gyis dbyig dug mchil ma rgyun ma chad par nyi zer dngas ma chu'i phyed du sleb/ 'ja' tshon med na sbyar dug dma' rab na 'dug na lo dug dus su ma phyin pa/ nas gang tsam du 'dug na stod snod la gnas te bcos sla/ gting du mi 'gro khar lding na dug med do// rgya ru lto stong btang la lus khol na dug yod ces mkhas pa brang ti bas kyang bya/ mi khol na dug med/ rang gi chu btang ma thag la skra bcug ste/

thung khum tshig na dug yod/ ma tshig na med do// 'khar rdo bsregs te mchil ma btab ste bcag pas nag po 'ja' tshon 'dra na dug yod/ ci yang med na dug med do// nya bzung la kha la gtad na de ma thag kha rlangs kyi dug gis shi na dug yod/ ma shi na med lags so// gnyis pa dug bcos pa'i man ngag la/ dug gi rigs gang yin gang na yod kyang rung ste/ sngon la bsdu/ des sbyang bar bya'o// dang po bsdu ba la/ rnyed na rigs ngan gyi/ ma rnyed na 'dra ste/ khrag dron mo'i nang khyor gang la/ du/ klad pa mnyes te dud 'gro ma gtogs pa'i/ 'tshags la/ dron mo 'tshal du stsal/ mod la rlon pa gzhug go /thag nas rlon na dug gzhan yod kyang de la 'du'o// yang rta'i gong ma ltar blta bas dus su ma skyugs na skyugs sman gtang*/ gnyis pa ni/ dug gsar pa 'thung ste/ nad stod na yod na skyugs sman/ nad rnying ste smad na yod pa 'dra na sbyang du bya'o// bshal skyugs kyi rim pa la/ byis pa lo bcu'i chu la/ dzā ti/ la phug nyungs thun mi chung tsam/ kar/ spang rgyan zhib btags btang ngo*// yang na 'bru nya dres ma sngas rtsa ba dkar po/ dkar po/ ka mo nya/ thar nu/ dzā ti/ la phug gser mdog mchin pa/ lcum rtsa rnams cha mnyam btags chu bskol phor gang la sbyar la btang bas yar skyugs/ mar 'khru'o// stod nad 'dren/ smad nad 'thon/ 'dis ma sleb na/ dug gsar rnying 'dra ste/ dug la bshal rang btang ste/ dan rog lce ma bton pa lnga/ a ru ra ser po lnga zhib par btags te dar tshags sbrang rtsis ril bu byas te btang bas/ dug tu 'khrus na bzang*/ yang na bkru sman du/ thar nu bzang po/ yang na bul bzang po/ yang na sug pa bzang po/ de rnams zhag gcig chu dron phul gsum la sbangs la/ chu grang rkyang bskol la phul gang po de/ bya sgros btang*/ yang bkru ba dang gso ba gnyis ka go chu rub tu btang ba ni rgya'i ming shi ba/ bod kyi ming skar ma gang dang 'dra bar btang ngo*// zas snyoms spyod lam tsha grang dang sbyar ro// dug gsar rnying 'dra ste/

dug khong du bsad pa'i sman la/ sbrul mkhris nas tsam gcig gong dang 'dra bar btang*/ yang na rus sbal gyi mkhris pa nas tsam gcig gong dang 'dra bar btang ngo*// yang na go snyod btses pa'i khu bas/ shel ljang nag gam ljang gu ser po mchog tu bzang*/ yang na shel thams cad dug la bzang ste/ shel rdo zhib par btags la gong gis phul la btang ngo*// yang 'dzad dkor yang gong dang 'dra ba mjug gi man ngag lags/ yang na shing mngar gyi khu ba la/ gla ba dri 'dzin gcig gi waṃ sha ril tsam gcig btang*/ yang na stag dom gyi mkhris pa mar dang bcas btang*/ 'di rnams gang rung za ma bdun gyi bar btang ngo*// dug gsar te nang khrol la gnas na/ sman gyis thub/ de rnying ste rtsa la zhen na sman dang gtar gyis thub/ de nas rnying pa rus pa la zhen pa mang*/ gdon gyis dkrugs na sngags kyis min pa gzhan gyis mi thub/ de la sngags kyis srung zhing bcos thabs la/ rdo rje khyung khra'i sngags kyis mdzad/ de la rang bsnyen pa rdzogs dgos/ bsnyen pa phog man ngag bzhin sngags kyis dngul chu thul ba'i tshad byung nas rdzas dngul chu la sngags kyi nus mthus btul/ nyin re zho phyed phyed bsten pas lus mdangs rnyed/ dug rnams rang gi grogs byas te/ rma bya 'dra nges pa 'byung ba'i gdams pa 'di/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud dgongs pa'i le lag kho bo sa skya rdzong chung pa la min pa/ lha yi gtsug na yang ji ltar yod snyam pa med/ sman chen gyis byed kyang*/ gong dang 'dra bas sngags rtsa sngags la 'ga' re tsam btags nas lag g.yon gyi mthe bong la sngags nas mnan/ g.yas kyi mdzub mo sogs la yi ge 'bru lnga bkod la btul/ za lugs rnams gong dang mtshungs so// dug byang ma byang lta ba ni/ khrag las shes so// khrag shing khras bshags pas slob slob 'og nas sran nyungs kar tsam gyi nag thig yod do// de'i ming phur pa zer/ de la tshwa btab ste thub tu song na byung nges so// ma song na chus bkrus te bltas pas sngon dmar ram/

dmar ser du 'dug na mi sos so// ngo bo rang du ma 'gyur na/ glo ba la babs na glo sman/ mchin pa la mchin sman sogs mdor na nad gang babs kyi sman gyis kha bsgyur bshal dang bsang sman la bsre'o// bsang sman rtsa la 'dus sam/ sha bar du tsha khyug khol bu mes tshig pa 'dra ba rnams la'am/ yang na sha ro 'dug pa rnams gong 'og the gus bkyigs la/ gtsags bus phug la dmar sal le 'dug na/ de 'phral du bcos ran no// dud khu sogs sna tshogs 'dug na/ dug byang ma byang lta ba'i phyir sogs gong dang 'dra/ btsan dug la rnyed na rigs ngan/ ma rnyed na khrag dron mo btang*/ des bshal/ skyugs/ sha dug la gong gi nyung kar sngags so// khyi dug la gong dang phal cher 'dra la/ sgos bcos brtag pa gcig kyang zur du blta'o// dug dbang po lnga la babs na so sor bsad de/ mig la babs na/ stag gi rus pa'i sman mar/ lce la ni tso'i= sna la spyang ki'i= rna ba la bya rgod kyi= dbang po lnga la babs pa sogs la cong zhi/ lcags phye/ sbrang rtsi'i sman mar gyis bzlog nges so// khyung gi man ngag rgya'i rgyal po'i bsad gso'i lag len dang mthun par 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas rgya'i lha rje la gnang ba'i lung blangs nas yi ger bkod pa'i cha lag rnams 'bri bsdus zab mo gzungs kyi ming can kho bos bris/ bla ma'i gsung gis 'di sa skya'i gser chos rang yin/ gser srang re mi 'bul re mna' dgag par mdzad lags so// brgyud pa rnams khyung dang mtshungs so// / / ༈ /rang rma byar gsal bar bsgom/ sgrub na rang nyid khyung du bsgom/ oṃ byi thun la tsa n+ya/ ma hā bi ṣa mā ra/ bhi sha phas/ hi hoḥ ma hī du khi/ phas le shwi nā tan ban swā hā/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ bdun ma chag par bzlas/ sha dug btsan dug bse dug thub/ brgya rtsa re re bzlas gyur na/ dbyig dug sbyar dug thams cad thub/ blo la med na gser gyis bris la mgul du btags/

dug byung ma byung brtag pa na/ gser gyis tshag med bris la shog dril zangs sam lcags kyi ga'ur bcug la ske ru btags/ srung ba 'khrol zhing sgra 'od dam// lus sbrid 'dar dang dngangs pa dang*// tshig dang rtse'i sgra 'ong nges// dug srung brtag thabs zab mo ste// bong nga za ba'i shog dril gcig /zur du bris par blta bar bya// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /ye shes khyung khra'i las tshogs drug pa mkho ba mdor bsdus bzhugs so// na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ye shes khyung khra'i las tshogs la drug ste/ bod nga'i bca 1 ུda len/ gcan gzan gyis so btab 2 pa gso ba/ dug sra 3 ུnga ba/ dug khong du song ba 4 zlog pa/ nad phyogs med 5 'joms pa'i thabs/ de'i gegs bas 6 la ba dmigs pa'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ sman chen lag mthil du bzhag la/ mdzub mo lnga la yi ge bkod nas/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bong nga dang dbyer med du gyur te bdud rtsir gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab bo// oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ stong la sogs pa bzlas nas zos na nad gdon gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing bcud len du 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ sman la sogs pa'i steng du rang gi mdzub mo lnga yi ge lnga'am/ khyung lngar bsam la/ de gang na ba'i sar byabs pas khyung rnams kyis 'dre gdon thams cad zos/ sngags kyi nus pas skrangs pa la sogs bsregs/ yig 'bru rnams las bdud rtsi babs pas nad pa'i lus khengs par bsams la/ sngags bzlas te/ sngags chu khong du btang bar bya/ 'di la bum pa byas kyang 'gal ba med do// gsum pa ni/ rang bya khyung du bsam/ mdzub mo lnga khyung lngar bsam/ zas gang yin la reg pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsam zhing*/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma bsgoms nas bong nga zos na nad mi yongs ba'i gdams pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ pho ba'i nang du khyung mang po bsgoms nas zos par bsam zhing sngags bzlas so// lnga pa ni/

sman zho gang chen/ gla bcu cha gnyis/ rtsi/ a brgyad 'gyur zer yang rus pa bton pa'i zho gang*/ shu dag nag po/ gu gul nag po/ ru rta 'di rnams zhib par btags dge slong ngam/ byis pa lo brgyad pa'am/ yang na gu gul gyi chu dang sbyar la 'dam 'thag yun ring du byas la ril bu gang 'grub byas te/ thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du bcug nas/ na bza' gsol/ rang gi mdun du bzhag la/ rang dang sman rnams k+ṣiṃ las dam tshig par bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ pū dzas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ sngags bzlas pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ brtan g.yo'i bcud kun bsdus nas yi ge la thim par bsam mo// bzlas pa'i mthar/ khyung kun 'od du zhu nas ril bu la thim pas ril bur gyur par bsam/ de lta bu zhag bdun la sogs pas bsgrubs nas ril bu ma nyams par byas te/ nad gdon gang la yang phyogs med du btang bas chog go /drug pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar hrīḥlas kha sar+pa ṇir bskyed do// ye shes pa dgug gzhug cing*/ de'i thugs kar sngags bkod la bzlas pa byas na rang la mi 'pho ba dang*/ lhog pa la sogs pa skrangs 'bur la lhag par phan/ rang gi bshang lam du yi ge hūm̐ dmar po mgo thur du bstan par bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bshang lam na mar song bar bsam zhing sngags bzlas na nad gdon thams cad dang khong ba'i sbos pa thams cad la phan/ rang gi thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba 'byung ba lnga'i nad la kha dog sna tshogs gsungs kyang*/ de dag gang yin brtag par dka' bas/ yi ge kha dog sna tshogs pa las 'od zer kha dog dang mtshungs pa spros nad gdon bsal bar bsams na/ nad gdon phyogs med la phan gdags pa'i dmigs pa'o// las tshogs drug po 'di cung zad mkho ba mdor bsdus pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i las sbyor brgyad pa bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/

rdo rje khyung khra'i las sbyor la brten pa'i dug bong nga bsten pa dang*/ dug bcos pa'o// dang po ni rang gi lag pa'i mthil du bong nga bzhag la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la pa/ gung mo la k+ṣiṃ/ srin lag la swā/ mthe chung la hā/ de rnams kha dog dkar po las bdud rtsi dkar po byung nas bong nga la thim pas/ bong nga bdud rtsir gyur par bsam zhing*/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas nas/ rang za ba'am/ gzhan la sbyin na/ grang ba dang*/ snying rlung dang*/ tshad pa la sogs pa'i nad zhi zhing bcud len rnams kyi'ang mchog go /de bzhin du dmigs pa de dang ldan na/ g.yos pa'i dug dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ sbyar dug gi gnod pas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// dug bcos thabs rgyas pa zhig logs su lta'o// gzhan yang*/ klu/ lhog pa/ sdig pa/ sbrul/ sre mong*/ khyi smyon la sogs pa dug can rnams kyis so btab pa rnams kyang dug rigs yin te/ de rnams la yi ge bkod pa'i lag pas byab pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma btab pa dang*/ sngags chu blud pa ni/ de dag gi dug thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// bsnyen sgrub khyad par can gyis khyung bsgoms la/ sngags bzlas/ de nas rus sbal gyi rus pa'i phye ma/ go bo'i gre ba/ go thal/ spyang ka'i brun/ yung ba'i phye ma ste/ de rnams gong gi man ngag bzhin btags la/ sngags btab ste chang bzang po la rta byas btang bas/ gre ba'i nad che ba rnams sel lo// yang bsnyen sgrub kyi khyung bsgom/ sngags bzlas/ bong 1 nga*/ gu gu 2 la/ gser 3 mdog de gsum la ril bu yungs 'bru tsam byas te gsum bdun bcu gcig btang na/ gnyan tshad rnams kyi nad las grol lo// yang gong bzhin la/ nu thar nu/ zho can/ zab ber can/ chu rtsa/ dar thod can/ re lcag gri sha dri 'dzin tsam gyi ril bu'i tshad bra ba'i ril ma tsam grangs gong dang 'dra ba btags na nad brgya sman gcig go /yang gong bzhin las mu ku ta

dngul chu/ zho re la/ mu zi/ nag po zho re/ khong sman chen zho gang*/ gser mdog mchin pa zho sha gsum gsum btang ba'i ril bu bra ril tsam grangs gong dang 'dra ba bsten na nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi zhing*/ skam mdze/ rlon mdze/ dreg grum gyi cha lag rnams dang*/ nam mkha'i nad 'joms par byed do// sman de rnams la bsnyen sgrub kyi khyung grangs med bstims la/ khyung ril du sgrub pa byed pa 'di gnad che zhing*/ man ngag gzhan dang 'gran pa'i zla med do// bum pa'i cho ga ni/ dang po spyi dang mthun pa legs par bshams la/ de'i nang du khyung khra bsgom/ mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas bzlas pa cung zad byas te/ gsol ba btab/ bum chus khrus dang byab srung dang*/ 'thung ba dang*/ zas la hub re bsre ba sogs byas na/ 'dis kyang gre ba'i nad sel/ grib dang mi gtsang ba sogs las grol bar nges so// gtor ma nya sha la sogs pas brgyan pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ a kā ros byin gyis brlab mdun du khyung bskyed pa'am/ spyan drangs la/ ga ru ḍā ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ

ham̐k+ṣamalawaraya btags so// ba lin+ta nā ga khā his mchod cing bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ mi dmigs pas rgyas gdab bo// de ltar byas pas/ gnas skabs su/ mdze dang*/ klu nad dang*/ gzhan yang gza' nad la sogs pa rnams zhi zhing*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// nā ro paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje khyung khra sgrub pa'i las sbyor brgyad pa/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung rgyun ltar zhal shes dang bcas pa/ sems can la phan pa'i bsam pas gzungs pa'i ming can gyis/ sa skya rdzong chung du sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i dreg bcos pa'i las mtha' bzhugs so// na mo ḍā ki ga ru ḍā ya/ rdo rje khyung khra'i las sbyor la brten nas dreg 'don pa'i man ngag rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i zhal shes gnad dang bcas pa/ za 'og gi ras ma lta bu 'di bri bar bya'o// thog mar zla ba gzas zin pa nas mgo 'dzugs/ yang na 'gyur che ba'i dus/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang rdo rje khyung khrar bsgoms la bsnyen sgrub bya/ rab khri/ 'bring stong*/ tha ma brgya rtsa sogs kyis bsnyen par bya'o// de nas sngon 'gro rang srung ba ni/ raṃ dzaṃ tri ga nan mā ra ya rbad/ ces nyer gcig sogs bgrang ngo*// nad pa'i khong srung la/ bzang drug gi thun zho phyed tsam re/ gla ba dri thon tsam re/ mar rnying pa la sbyar ba'i ril bu bong rlig tsam re zla ba phyed bar la bsten no// dreg langs nas zla ba gsum lon pa dang nad kyi rtsal rdzogs la/ dang po na ba'i dmigs legs par btsal la/ der rgya shog la rgya mtshal gyis dbus su gzab chung gis a/ de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du ra dbu nang du bstan pa brgyad bris la nad dmigs su lhan gyis sbyar/ sems can la gtong len bsgom/

babs babs/ 'ub 'ub/ rbad rbad/ rbud rbud/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes chu ser gyi sdud sngags 'di byed/ gang na sar lan gcig btab bo// dngos gzhi chu ser 'gyur pa'i sman la/ spos dkar/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ zar ma rnams cha mnyam/ kyi lce ba dang*/ chu rtsa cha mnyam/ gzhan so ma rā dza/ 'u su/ thal kar rdo rje/ skyer ba'i bar shun rnams gang 'dzom btang ngo*// ra dkar mo'i 'o ma'am/ ba dkar mo'i 'o ma gang rung la sbyar la nad dmigs ma gtogs skrangs mtha' ma shor bar bskus/ bskams rjes yang yang byug nad kyi ngo bo 'don pa'i sngags la/ rang ye shes kyi khyung gshog pa ye shes kyi me ru byas pa/ sder mo zangs las byas pa zhig gis klu rigs thams cad dbang du sdud par bsams la/ sngags ni/ hab phye hub phye/ kā la raṃ phye/ kā la nā ga phye/ ba spu'i bu ga phye/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas la/ nyin nub gnyis kar nad dmigs dang*/ a ru ra la btab cing*/ rang khyung khrar bsgoms la sngags bzlas/ gtor ma 'bul/ nad drag par gsol ba btab/ sa la mi lhung ba'i rkan brdab la bya khyung gi gshog pa dang*/ mjug ma sprugs pas nad kyi dngos po bshig par bsams la/ sder mos nad 'dzin mchus rngubs pas nad thams cad zhu ru ru khug par bsam/ rwa'i nang du sha 'bur byung ba dang*/ rgya tshwa nas tsam glan la rwa 'dzugs/ lpags pa srab 'thug gi shugs kyis/ zhag gsum gyi bar du chu sgong nges par 'ong*/ der rang zhar la song nas chu ser ma zad bar du sman gyi byugs pa dang*/ dreg 'don pa'i sngags btab/ rwa 'dzugs/ chu ser zad pa dang*/ dreg ro byi'u phrug gi gshog pa 'dra ba khra zing nge ba 'ong*/ gnyan med na gtsags bus snga zur nas bcad nas bskyur/ shul dmar ding nge ba gcig 'ong*/ de gtsags bus nas tsam du gtsags la/ rwa btsug nas khrag a ru drug bdun gcig 'don no// gnyan tshad cher yod na chu sgong cher 'ong*/ kha dog dmar po dmar rtsa shig ge 'ong*/

rtsa yang rgyu/ de la me byas pas zhag 'ga' re nas rnag yong*/ de nas rwa 'dzugs/ dreg ro mas bcad/ phyis khrag chu zad zad bton/ sha 'bur ba chu sgong myur du 'ong bas/ chen po 'byung ba/ dkar khra/ nag khra/ mdog ser ba sogs la gtsags bus bcad do// rjes bcad la/ sman gyi khung bzos la mkhris chen dang gri khrag la sbyar/ theng gsum bkru/ sngags/ khre be khre be/ zhes pa 'di mang du bzlas la btab/ shul du gser gyi me btsa' bya/ de la chu ser yod na/ gser gol go rlon zer ba'ang snang*/ glan no// dal bar bsdad/ chu ser bskyed pa'i zas zhag 'ga' spang ngo*// yang tsha dreg drod che/ rlangs pa yong*/ gnyan med na gtar dang rwa 'phrod/ grang dreg drod chung 'brum bu 'ong*/ sngags brdeg sman bsku/ rwa btsugs/ dang po chu bur 'byung zhing bcings pas de nas chu ser 'byung*/ de ltar gtor ma phul la nyin re bzhin gong ltar skran dang chu ser thon/ thon sar rwa btsug par bya'o// dreg gnyan grum bu sogs thon nges so// gnyan la rwa spang ba gal che'o// de'i bar khyung sngags rnams bzlas la btab bo// sman dngul chu sngags kyis btul ba'am/ rdzas kyis btul ba gang rung re zla ba'i bar bsten no// man ngag lag len zhal shes gong mas mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la dreg byung dus su dpal gyi ming can gyis sa skyar bkod pa'o// brgyud pa khyung khra dang mtshungs so// rjes gnang ma thob pa dang*/ 'gro don med pa la dpe ma ston cig sa skya rdzong chung ba'i khyung khra'i las tshogs 'di la gser chos rang mdzad pa yin gsungs lags// ༈ /dreg gi nad byung ba'am/ byung gis dogs pas sgom bzlas thun bzhi'am gsum gnyis gcig la sogs pa byed/ de la dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang khyung khra'i mngon rtogs blang*/ bzlas pa gong bzhin bya'o// khyad par tho rangs gnyid sad ma thag

me ris kyi srung bas mtshams ma shor bar bskor ro// chab gtor/ klu gtor/ zan gtor ma chag par bya'o// dgun yang de bzhin bya'o// de ltar byas pas sdig pa chung ba'o// bka' rgya shin tu dam// / / ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i las tshogs las/ mdze gso ba'i las tshogs bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/ rdo rje khyung khra la brten nas mdze gso ba la don gsum ste/ dang po brtag pa/ bar du gso thabs/ tha ma rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lus la brtag pa/ ngag la brtag pa/ yid la brtag pa/ rmi lam la brtag pa'o// dang po ni/ byad la sogs pa lus kyi sha 'gyur ldog mang ba dang*/ sha ser sob dang*/ sngo sob dang*/ nag sob dang*/ sha che ba de rnams la bya spu gtor ba lta bu bug pa sreb pa/ drag shul ma byas kyang khrag skye ba dang*/ rnag khrag 'ong ba dang*/ sha ro zug mi tshor bar 'bur ba dang*/ zug med kyang gsos su mi 'dod pa'am rma yong ba dang*/ shu ba dang*/ chu bur yong ba dang*/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad tsha breng breng ba dang*/ chad 'gro ba lta bu yong*/ rkang lag gi nywa bzhi 'gul ba dang 'phrig pa yong*/ smin ma dang skra mtshams za ba dang*/ ba spu nyung du 'gro ba dang*/ ba spu med pa'i sha ko le 'ong*/ sha la dri ma mi chags pa dang*/ lus chus bkrus pas/ zil pa mi chags pa dang*/ la lar chu chags la/ la lar mi chags pa sogs 'dug na nad zhugs pa'i rtags yin no// gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi skad 'gyur ba dang*/ glo bur du skad 'gags pa dang*/ 'dzer ba dang*/ dig pa/ mi thon pa/ sna shu ba/ gre ba shu ba/ rgyang skad mi thon pa/ thon kyang 'dar ba/ chad kyin 'gro ba/ skad gsang mi thon pa rnams yin no// gsum pa ni/ rkyen med bzhin du snying 'tshub hril yong ba dang*/ blo kyog pa/ gang byed med pa/ yi chad pa/ 'gro snying 'dod pa/ brjed ngas che ba/ gnyid che ba rnams yin no// bzhi pa ni/ nags tshal gseb na 'dug pa/ chu mig dang sbal sbrul nya lcong rmi ba/

lus la 'jug pa/ gcan gzan gyis 'ded pa/ lder so gog pos ded pa/ ser ba 'ong ba/ mdze pho dang 'grogs pa/ nyi ma nub pa/ nam srod pa/ mun nag la 'thum pa sogs rmi na/ spyir lus rtags la gdon gyis thebs pa yin/ ngag gi rtags la smin pa yin/ yid kyi rtags la skyob pa'i lha dang bral ba yin/ smin ma byi ba lpags dug skor mig rus dug song ba yin no// mig gi rtsa ris la brtag pa ni/ 'og gi rtsa ris slong steng nas rtsa ris la brtag pa ni/ sne la nag zig 'dug na/ bsnyen pa drag tu byed dgos/ rtsa ris rnams nyung du song ba dang*/ nag thig ser thig chung du song na/ 'tshe bas 'bad par bya'o// che ru 'gro na tshogs gsog bskul ba ma gtogs phan pa med do// gnyis pa gso ba la/ bsnyen pas gso na nor rdzas nye 'brel sogs gang la yang zhen pa med par rgyang dor/ nga mdze pho mi khyu nas bud pa yin/ rab tshe 'dir rkyen ngan grogs su shar nas sangs rgyas thob pa'am/ mtha' ma yang ngan song gsum du mi skye ba zhig bya snyam du zhe bcad/ bsnyen pa'i lha ni/ nad 'di'i gnyen po/ gdon 'di'i grol lam/ bla med kun gyi nying khu dus 'khor khros pa'i ngo bo rdo rje khyung khra la bya'o// man ngag mngon rtogs mdze nad las grol dus blta bar bya'o// nang gi sman du/ ma gi ta dang*/ mu men/ gla rtsi gsum gyis khong srung rgyun du bya'o// yang na khyung lnga'i khong srung bya'o// sbyor ba rnams ni man ngag ltar ro// phyi'i byug pa ni rgya tshwa/ sgog skya/ khyim bya'i sgo nga'i ser thig stod mi bde na byad la byug smad mi bde na khyi lud dang mkhan pa gnyis cha mnyam/ ra'i rwa brdar ba blug dri chu la sbyar bar bya'o// pus mo man la byug go /sha ro byung na ma gi ta/ mu zi/ ldong ros gsum ra'i 'o ma la brdar nas byug glang shu 'dra ba byung na khyi lce chang la sbyar ba byug sha khra byung na btsan dug dang ra dug chang la sbyar bas byug

tshan lus la phag tshil byug snying mi dga' na mi tshil 'o ma snying gar byug go /mdze srung ba la bris pa 'khor los srung ba dpe chung ltar ro// rdzas kyis srung ba la dug khrag gis srung ba bum thang ma ru shes par bya'o// sman rdzas kyis srung ba ni/ btsan dug ma gi ta/ gu gul/ sgog skya/ shing kun/ ba bla/ ldong ros/ mu zi/ rma bya'i sha mdze rus/ rta rus/ khyi rus/ spyang brun/ rta bon/ phag tshil/ gri sha de rnams kyis thub pas lus la gdags so// zab // ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i thog srung gi las mtha' bzhugs so// na mo ga ru ḍā ya/ bsnyen pa 'khyol nas/ thog srung na thub/ gzhan yang gser ram mtshal la gri khrag bsres nas/ yig 'bru lnga bcangs pas thub/ yang rang dang rigs mthun pa sems can thog gis bsad pa'i rus pa dang*/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i nang nyid du/ rang ming srung ba 'bru lnga bris/ mu khyud nang ma la rigs lnga/ phyi ma la 'di nyid bri/ thag ser ur nan rbad rbad/ bzhi ru bri/ rab tu gnas byas btags pas thub// yang na thog ris nang du ni// dbus su k+ṣi dang 'bru lnga bkod// shar du rang ming bri bar bya// bcos pa ni/ rdo thog lcags thog bong thog gsum// rdo thog 'thor dang 'dril ba gnyis// lcags la 'dril dang mda' lar 'khyug /khong thog 'thor zhes rgyud las gsungs// snying po babs na ldog pa dka'// zer dang 'thor ba byung gyur na// chu brdeg man ngag gzhan dang 'dra// zhag gcig bar du reg mi rung*// a gar brgyad dang skyo tshas kyang*// de nas sngags chus zhag gsum brab// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung*// khyung gi las mtha' zab mo 'di// 'phags pa zhes byas shing kun tu// bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bris// sa māp+ta mi thi/ sa skya'i gser chos kho na rang yin// / / ༈ /khyung gi las mtha' gegs sel gzer lnga bzhugs so// bla ma dang rdo rje khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// gegs sel gzer lnga'i snyan brgyud yi ger 'bri bar bya'o// de la rtsa bshal/

lto bshal/ gtsug bshal/ smad bshal/ rna bshal dang lnga las/ stod kyi glo bshal/ mkhal ma'i drod bshal/ chu'i skyugs kha chu sogs/ bshal/ mchin pa'i 'dam bshal/ khrag bshal/ skran gyi spyod khrag bshal/ bshal/ mi rgod kyi gnam gnyan/ kyi rgyun sbyong*/ rgyal po'i chibs gong gi bshal rnams gsungs so// dang po rtsa lto'i sngon 'gro zhag 'ga' yig brgya sogs sgrib sbyong la 'bad/ sha gyong dang rul sum sogs mi mthun pa'i zas spang*/ mkhan pa/ sbang ma/ bul tog rnams mi bskyod pa la sbyar la lus la byug de rjes chu gtsang gis lus bkru/ sha ma dros pa la mar nag gam/ mar lo mang po lon pas byug pa legs par bya/ nangs par tho rangs gtong rgyu'i do nub lto mi za/ lto bshal sngon 'gro/ a ru ra mchu snyung lnga/ gser g.yer rdog dgu snang*/ mdog dgu/ spos dkar thun mi chung che ba gcig zer/ tsam zhib btags chu gtsang la bskol pa'i dwangs ma nyal khar blud la/ la la des phebs pa 'byung ngo*// dngos gzhi ni/ sman mchog snyung mo a ru ra/ bdun/ dan rog lce 'don bcu gcig tsam/ dur byid mtheb tshigs tsam/ thar nu zho gang lhag tsam/ rang gi dri chen ril ma tsam gcig zhib par gtags/ ras khug tu kha btsems rdza gsar du ja bskol ba bzhin bya/ de drod ma yal tsam la btung*/ yang na gi'u waṃ zho gang*/ pa ti zho phyed mu zi ser po gnyis/ shog shing zho gang*/ dan rog zho do'am gang rnams gong bzhin btang bas/ nad stod na yod na skyugs/ smad du yod na bshal du 'gro/ bar na yod pa rnams rang zhir 'gro/ de la nad gang gi gnyen por sman gyi kha bsgyur ba ni/ khyi smyon la rdo pha wang*/ la cha mes ma bsregs pa/ dug spyi la bse ru dkar po/ a ru ra gser mdog mu zi/ ko byi la/ srin rgyug pa rnams so// gza' la/ gza' dug pa/ ser po/ sngon po/ dkar po/ pho nad la/ rgyam tshwa/ lga skya/ drod 'jog pi pi ling*/

se 'bru/ mchin pa la gu gul/ gi waṃ/ brag zhun/ cong zhi/ mkhal ma la/ smad kyi 'bras gsum/ nyi dga'/ glo ba la/ sro lo/ ru rta/ shing mngar/ rgun 'bru/ rlung la/ a ga ru/ snying zho sha dzā ti/ shing kun/ sgog skya/ go snyod/ sha chen/ bur dkar/ a bar skyur gsum sogs/ gnyan tshad la gla rtsi/ stag sha gu gul/ 'dzim pa rnams btang*/ bshal dus lus zungs bzang na thengs sum cu tsam/ ngan na bcus phan/ 'byam na thug pa la mar btab la btang*/ de nas gsum bzhi 'grim yang mi skyon/ 'byangs pa'i tshad rgyu ma'i shun pa 'dra ba byung na gcod do// lcag tshad bzang po drod 'jam bsros pa la myong bas grub pa yin no// rjes gcod pa ni 'bras thug ston gyi gro ma mar btsos kyis gcod/ des ma chod na/ 'ob kyi spu'i sbyor ba bya'o// yang bshal du mi 'dod pa phar log na/ phabs/ thar nu/ tshwa mar gyi ring bu srin zhal du bcug pas bsu'o// yang rtsa nang du nad zhugs pas lus skam/ mdog mi mthun/ thig le lus la ma khrems pa/ chu yong dus zug tshan chen po yong ba sogs nad 'khren che na/ rtsa sbyor btang ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum la/ dang po gong dang 'dra/ dge slong tshul khrims ldan pa sogs la/ seng dkrug gsum gyi thang mi bskyod pa ma byon bar du btang*/ dngos gzhi rgya tshwa/ mtshal dkar/ thod le kor/ de rnams zho phyed re/ byang ba dmar khra bdun dgu bcu gcig sogs ras gtsang mar gtum rang dub tsam gyi seng pho la nub gcig spangs/ de nyid byas pa'i khu ba pho/ da gzod sing po'i chang la lag pas mnye/ byang ba nag po drag ser khra 'jam/ dmar khra dga'o// lung pa mi gcig pa gsum gyi ri la yang*/ skyer tsher gseb la bzang*/ rtsa gseb gzhan rnams ngan/ rgod shi ma gtogs gzhan gyi nus pa mi 'phrod pa yin/ de'i khu ba der gong gi sman gsum po btab/ dar la btsags te khu ba khab mig 'grim pa gsum tsam btang*/ chang bzang pos phul sman dang lcag byed/

gegs sel ni/ rtsa lam tsha na/ drod ril gyi phye ma dang khu ba lcag la btang*/ la la byang ba'i rkang pa gtong ba yang byed kyin 'dug go /gcod ran pa'i rtags su chu gtsang byung na ran no// mchod na 'ob kyi spu'i sbyor ba bya'o// lha rje rnams byang ba'i gshog pa dkar po bton nas byed kyin 'dug ste/ de rkyang pa la dug yod pa'i nges pa mi 'dug lan gcig sbangs de'i khu ba bton pas gang la yod kyang thon pa yin lags/ gtsug bshal la/ mgo la srin bu'am/ bad rlung la sogs pa'i nad yod pa'am/ gza' nad srin du 'khyog pa/ rgyun du mgo bo la zug yod pa sogs la/ mgo bo'i skra

sgos su byed na bzang*/ bzhar la/ g.yu chung ba/ sran chung ba/ so ma rā tsa/ tha skar rdo rje/ spos dkar rnams zhib par btags la/ mi bskyod pa sbyar ba khod snyoms su bsku/ skyi dkar legs pas dam par dkris la/ rlung ma shor bar bya'o// des mgo nad chu ser la sogs pa thams cad 'thon/ dmigs pa ni/ rang gi mgo bo thod skam du bsgom/ nad thams cad du ba'i rnam par sngo bun bun spyi gtsug nas ded/ rgya srubs nas 'thon par bsgom/ sna bshal/ li shi gsum/ thar nu gnyis/ la phug gsum po 'di yang yin no// yang mgron bu/ bong nga*/ sga skya/ sug pa bzhi po du ba ma shor bar mes bsregs pa'i thal ba/ byad ba dmar khra/ rgya tshwa cung zad cig rnams bsres pa'i sman ran pa tsam zhig snyugs ma'i sbubs nas bus pas 'thon no// 'ob kyi spu'i sbyor ba ni/ sla nga ru du rlangs ma shor bar bsregs pa'i gzhob dang*/ dom mkhris cha mnyam/ chang bzang pos phul la btang ba zhig yin no// sngags kyis gcod pa ni/ oṃ tri yungs sha li sha li swā hā/ brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la grib ma mthur du bcus pa'i chu la btab nas/ de yang tsha shas che na gangs chu/ grang shas che na chu bskol btang ngo*// 'dis dmar bshal yang thub bo// rtsa chu nam 'byongs par sha sogs spang bar bya/ gzhan rnams bshal spyi dang mthun no// gzer lnga'i gegs sel/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung nas byon phyag len bzhin du/ gzungs pa'i ming can gyis rdo rje khyung khra'i las mthar sbyar ba re zhig dge'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rgyal mo chu sbyong bzhugs so// chu sbyong bar byed pa la/ mdze tshwa zho gang*/ chu lam 'byed par byed pa la lcam pa zho phyed/ rtsa sbyong bar byed pa go snyod zho phyed/ rtsa mnyen par byed pa la pri yang ku zho phyed tsam/ phul byed chang ma sing gis byed/ dmu chu'i gdams pa dri chu lam 'dren zab/ yang gcig la/ tsha grangs phyed ma tsam la/ gze lcam skyu ru dang gsum cha mnyam pa'i thang btang*/

tsha shas che na/ gze lcam gyis phyed thub/ skyu ru ras phyed thub pa btang*/ dmu chu bcos pa'i man ngag phyag sman pa'i snying tig zab/ rang spyan ras gzigs su bsgom/ ba dmar mo'i chu bre phyed la sngags/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dharma tse sod/ sa srin me du sod/ me ku ru ku ru sod/ ces dang*/ chu rjes mur rgyu bu ram la/ ha la ha la big nan/ ces btab 'thung na rmu chu bshal du 'gro bas zab bo/ // ༈ /thur sel gyen log la/ sne'u'i 'bras bu/ 'ol mo/ kha ru tshwa gsum zhib par brdungs la/ chang tshod ma gang rung gis phul/ 'og rlung 'beb bo// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i ser ba srung ba'i las mtha' bzhugs so// na mo gu ru be/ phyag na rdo rje rta mgrin phyag rdor 'jam dpal rigs gsum 'dus pa'i drag sngags/ phyag cha rang nam grub pa ma thob gyi bar du sa lugs tshogs gsum/ la bskor ba zhes bya/ bla ma zhal dam pa ye shes dang bla ma lhun grub/ gnyis pa'i thugs dam du bzhed pa/ de la dang po rang nyid yi dam du bya ba la/ lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ bzla thabs dang gsum/ dang po bdag lhar bsgom pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog sku kham nag rat+nas brgyan pa'i snyan cha/ do shal/ mgur chu/ mthing ga sku stod la glang chen ko rlon/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu rigs bzhis sku la brgyan pa me ri me phung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par bsam mo// de'i dbu steng du rta mgrin rta mgo dmar po/ zhur dkar po/ rngog ma ljang gu/ rta skad phyogs bzhir sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga/ g.yon sdigs 'dzub gyi rtse las me 'bar ba/ me phung 'bar ba'i klong na nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon bskums pas bzhugs pa/ sku me ri me phung gi klong na bzhugs par bsam/

sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra sarba daṣ+ṭān dzaḥbh+yoḥ 'di ni rtsa sngags 'bru dgu zer ro// 'gong po 'dul byed kyi sngags ni/ gnod byed tsit+ta rbad/ tig nan badz+ra li dza rbad/ trig nan/ zhes sham bu gdags so// de yan chad rgyun du yi dam du byed/ bar chad bgegs srung ba'i gdams pa'o/ chu 'khyags/ /da ni ser ba bzlog par 'dod pas a bsnyen dus zlog ba a a/ bskyed rim snga ma ltar bsgom/ rtsa sngags oṃ badz+ra 'bru dgu'i gsham e sbyar la/ sprin phung sprin shig haṃ sgyur hūm̐ sgyur/ ye mo tshal sgyur/ pa ra tsa ti pa ya rbad/ badz+rī li dza rbad/ ces btags bsnyen pa bya'o// mgul khug tu nyungs khro bor bsams la/ kar dang*/ khrag thal chen me ru bsam/ sba lcag me'i 'khor lor bsam/ sna thun sna sngags la/ sprin phung mgo 'tshon sngags des bya/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ khro bo'i me yi gseb na khro chung yod par bsam/ 'od zer dang sngags kyi 'od zer mer gyur nas sprin rnams mes bsregs par bsam/ dmigs pa ni/ bar snang gi sprin rnams mes bsregs/ de'i 'od zer gyis ser ba zhu bar bsam/ tho mtshams su khro bo rbad mer bsam zhe sdang bskyed/ khro bo'i mes tshig par bsam/ sleb na gdong zlog gi sngags ni/ kiṃ kaṃ tsit+ta yab mgo bo dgu/ rbad/ trig yum sbal mgo naṃ/ rā hu la sras rā hu la/ tsit+ta rbad/ trig nan/ badz+ra li dza rbad/ ser bdag po mo'i tsit+ta rbad/ trig nan/ ser gtong gi nus pa tsit+ta rbad/ trig nan bya ba des zlog phyag cha rang la bskor ba zhes bya ba/ skyin thang srung ba'i man ngag zab/ // ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// ser ba srung ba'i man ngag 'di lta bu bya'o// dang po byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ des nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzhi bskor bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis bar chad bsrung bar bya/

de'i ched du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i las la 'god snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o// dang po sprin 'bud pa ni/ sprin 'di sa ma ya khos/ sprin 'di sa ma ya sod/ sprin 'di sa ma ya chod/ sprin 'di sa ma ya rbad/ ces shing bal rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du sprin gtor bas nam mkha' dwangs par bsgom/ 'brug gi ngar bcag pa ni/ 'brug 'di sa ma ya khos/ sa ma ya sod/ sa ma ya chod/ sa ma ya rbad/ ces so/ glog gi lce bcad pa ni/ glog 'di sa ma ya khos/ sa ma ya sod/ sa ma ya chod/ sa ma ya rbad/ ces so// de nas char pa 'dis 'bud do// oṃ mor ge sod/ 'brug 'di sod/ pra ma ni sod/ 'bur 'bur sod/ raṃ raṃ sod/ mu ti mu ti sod/ ni lam dun sod/ ces pa des char chad par 'gyur ro// des ma chad na 'di bya'o// nag po shu shu phaṭa/ tsan+dha ga ru ḍā na phaṭa/ dhe ba ma ra tsa phaṭa/ nā ga rā dza phaṭa/ ma ma shu shu phaṭa/ gha te gha te phaṭa/ ri bo kun ser ba ur+ṇa ma ṇi ye phaṭa/ ces sde brgyad kyi srog snying 'di bzlas pas chad par 'gyur ro// des bzlog go /des ma chod na 'di bya'o// rang nyid khro bo chen po dmar ser 'jigs su rung ba sprin gyi gseb na yar sleb pa zhig tu bsgoms la 'di bzla'o// oṃ ni laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas nas phu byas la nam mkha' thams cad dwangs par bsgom/ des chad par 'gyur ro// des ma chad na 'di ltar bya'o// rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog ser po gser btso ma ltar bsgoms la/ de'i zhabs 'og tu yul de'i lo thog chud par bsams la sngags 'di bzla'o// oṃ he he tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha ra ya ha ra ya/ ni ru tha ni/ ni ru tha ni/ ser pa pra t+yaṃ gi ra phaṭ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ ma hā kā la/ ser ba ur+ṇa ma ṇi ye/ ser ba sil sil bh+yo/ ser ba zhu zhu/ ser ba mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ser ba rbad rbad/ ser ba gtubs gtubs/
