ser ba chod chod/ ser ba tshal tshal/ ser ba myags myags/ ser ba chog chog ser ba sha trūm̐ s+t+wam+bhā ya nan rbad/ ser ba zlog sgyur bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas pas bus pas/ lha 'dre thams cad bcom bsregs par bsgom/ nam mkha' thams cad sngo tho re song bar bsgoms na char thams cad chad par 'gyur ro// ser ba gting 'dregs zlog pa 'di bya'o// oṃ bha ru kun dhe ye swā hā/ de bzlas pas ser ba gnas de nyid du mi 'khor bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro// maṅga laṃ/ ser ba srung ba'i gdams pa 'di bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa/ bod du bsgyur ba la 'di las zab pa bod khams tsam na yang med/ zab mi zab char pa bsrungs na mngon no// ser ba srung ba'i man ngag rdzogs so// char sngags 'bum tsho khri stong tsho brgya'i bar zlos mdzod dang char pa mi thub pa'i nyen med do// ༈ /bla ma dang yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// lo chog dang lo phud kyi phyag len ni/ dang po dbang chen la sna bo zhu ba dang*/ yul lha la srid btsan pa bya ba yin pas/ dang po dkon mchog dang chos skyong la phud dang gtor ma mnyes par phul la/ rang gi lo'i bcol gdams legs par zhu/ de nas yul lha la bshos bu dang*/ bar phud kyis mchod la/ ngas bsrungs pa'i ser khang la ser ba 'ong du ma 'jug cig khyed la bcol lo gtams so// mched grogs gyis shig ces bya'o// de nas gza' gdong dang rigs drug lan chags la/ chu gtor dang gtor ma lo glud kyis tshims par byas la/ ngas ser ba bsrung ba la/ lo legs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde skyid dang ldan par bya snyam pa'i sems bskyed/ byams snying rje drag po bsgom/ de ltar sngon 'gro byas la/ de nas tho phur ni/ pha shing tsher ma can la phur pa sor bzhi pa byas/ bud med kyi dor rta/ sham bu la gtums pa dang*/ rang yi dam gyi snying po shog bu la bris te/ tshon skud sna lngas bcings la gong gi gtor ma gtong ba'i dus na/

phur pa nas la btsugs la rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ rang gang mos pa'i khro bo bcur bskyed/ mchod pas mchod/ de nas phur pa gzug pa ni/ ri sna la sogs gang dgos sar gzug go /tho dang phur pa khro bo bcur bskyed la gzug go /ser khang de khro bo'i gur du gtams par bsgom/ gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang cis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom/ de tshe sngon 'gro dang las kha tshar ba'o// dngos gzhi las la sbyar ba ni/ man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi/ dang po nam mkha'i mthongs su sprin gyi gur bshig pa dang gcig ri thang mtshams su ser ba'i rkang bcag pa dang gnyis/ bar snang gi khams su 'khyags pa chu ru bzhu ba dang gsum/ sa gzhi'i steng du rlung gi gzhu bcag pa dang bzhi/ drag po 'brug gi ngar skad bcag pa dang lnga/ lam bstan pa dang gzhan gyi lo thog gzan la bskur ba dang drug ces kyang bzlog par dka' na gnam sa kha sbyor gyi log gnon bya ba dang bdun no// de nas 'di'i lugs la rang yi dam khro bo gang byed kyang chog go /dang po sogs gsum ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i sku las bskal pa'i me phung 'bar bas bsregs par bsam/ sngags bzlas nas bus pas/ mchil ma me phung mgar gyi tshwa tshwa 'dra ba lhag par 'tshubs pas sprin bsregs par bsam mo// bus pas ye shes kyi rlung gis sprin gtor bar bsgom mo// phyag mtshan la yang me yi 'khor lo dpag med 'phros nas sprin bsregs par bsam mo// phyag gis sprin gyi mgo nas bzung nas dril bar bsgom/ ba spu'i bu ga nas khro bo g.yas pa rlung gi 'khor lo thogs pa dpag med spros te phyag mtshan gyis bcad gtor g.yengs dkrugs te sprin dngos med du btang bar bsgom/ rlung gis me bskyod sprin bsregs par bsam zhing*/ sa rdo thams cad khro bo dang me ru bun bun song bar bsam/ rang yi dam gang byed kyi bsnyen pa 'khyol nas rtsa sngags kyi sham du 'byung ba rang ldog gi sngags gdags so// ser ba shag krum rak+ṣaṃ s+t+wam bhā ya rbad phaṭa raṃ/

trag saṃ khaṃ raṃ/ dz+wa la raṃ/ rak+ṣa raṃ/ badz+ra badz+ra/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes pa'i drag sngags 'di zhe sdang drag pos bzlas la 'bud do// 'di bus pas ser ba zhing thog tu 'bab mi srid do// brgya la ser ba shor yang srung ba'i sngags rgod 'khyags pa chu ru bzhu ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ mda' gzhu khyung la sogs skyer pa'i mda' gzhu khyung du bsgoms la 'phong*/ par bsgom/ lnga pa ni/ bya khyung gis 'brug gi ya 'gal ma 'gal nas bzung gshags par bsgom/ drug pa gzhan gyi lo tog gzan la bskul ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ser bdag gang yin pa de'i sems la phog pas gnod sems zhi nas/ gzhan gyi 'dod yon rnam lnga tshang bar rang gi ser khong gi dod por khyer bas rang la dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar bsam/ log non gyi chos skyong srung ma tsho mthu ma chung*/ rtsal ma zhan/ mthu dpung skyed cig ces brjod cing g.yab nag brdul te/ gong ba phar bstan/ gsham nas bzung ste brdab bo// bdun pa ni/ ye shes lha'i me phung gis ri rdo sa brag thams cad gzhob tu bun bun song ste gnam sa kha sbyar te/ de'i steng du bdag nyid sku che la yan lag rags pa drag por byed pa bsgom pa de ni man ngag go// / / man ngag 'di'i lugs kyi dgun nyi gzhu khyim gyi dus na bsnyen pa zhag bcu tsam zhig bya/ de dus lha bsnyen gyi sham du/ 'byung ba rang ldog gi sngags gdags la sngags so// de yang thun sngags pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thun dang po gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ thun rdzas khro chung me 'bar ba/ za za 'cha' 'cha' 'dra ba la/ lag na mtshon thogs par bskyed/ de la sngags bzlas la thud thud byas pas/ rab gnas dbang bskur gyi tshul du gyur pas/ de rnams nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa che bar bsgom// / / bsam gyi ral gri la yi ge 'di mdung tshugs su bri'o// mai tri phaṭa nan/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams brgyad du tho btsug go

/kha ba srung ba'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// ༈ /rdo rje khyung khra'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// 'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen bzhi la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i gshog pa ldan// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa'i// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// khyung gi sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sa phyogs gtsang ma'i gnas su/ sngon 'gro bya/ sa slang ba'i cho ga gang yang rung ba'o/ sa dbyibs legs par snyoms pa'i khar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag tu bya/ shing bra ma'am/ skyer pa'am/ tsher ma rnams so// me bram ze'i rgyun bzhag lta bu las len/ me shing la bsang gtor byas nas me sbar/ mngon rtogs ltar rdo rje khyung khrar bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ mar nag gam ske tshes me gso/ dgang gzar du dgra'am bgegs kyi liṅga rten drug las byas pa/ ming rus kha byang rnams la 'gugs 'dren skad cig gis dzaḥdzaḥbarjod la/ khyung gi zhal du btab pas/ lus thal ba rdul phran/ rnam shes chos nyid myang 'das su bzhag go /dgra bgegs 'di zhes bya ba mā ra ya nan/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ga ru ḍā mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod/ bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin gsal ba gal che'o// ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ sbyin sreg thal ba bsgrub bya'i khyim nang du bzhag go /de ni srung ba'i mchog go /gzhan las kyi rjes mi mngon pa sogs spyi ltar bya'o// sbyin sreg gi las mtha' 'phags pas shing kun tu byas pa'i yi ge pa ni kho bo nyid do// dge bas 'gro kun gdon las grol bar shog/ ༈ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i cha rgyun ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ brtan g.yo'i dug rnams ye shes kyi// bdud rtsis 'joms mdzad bla ma dang*// dbyer med rdo rje mkha' lding la// btud nas de yi man ngag dbye// 'di la gsum/

sgrub pa'i thabs/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga las tshogs kyi nges pa'o// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bsgom pa spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su klu chen po brgyad bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rig pa k+ṣiṃ ljang sngon las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khyung khra sku mdog sna tshogs pa'i mdangs can/ brla gnyis man chad sa dag pa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu dag pa'i rang bzhin dkar po/ snying ga me dag ba'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgrin pa nas smin mtshams man chad rlung dag pa'i rang bzhin ljang gu/ spyi bo nam mkha'i rang bzhin sngon po/ rdo rje'i rwa dang mchu shin tu rno ba/ sder mo zangs las grub pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs shing*/ khro gnyer dpral ba'i dbyings su bsdus pa/ smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing*/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug nas phrogs pa'i nor bu rin po che rwa g.yas kyi phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ g.yon gdug pa can thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pas nor bu'i phreng ba bsnams pa/ rdo rje'i mchus sbrul gdug pa zhal du gsol zhing rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa rgyab nag po/ mdun dkar po/ bar mtshams dmar po can nam mkhar gdengs shing rdeb pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na khams gsum dbang du sdud cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/

ye shes sems dpa' rigs lnga'i ngo bo dbus su rdo rje'i khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ shar du 'khor lo'i khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che'i khyung ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma'i khyung dmar po g.yas pad+ma/ byang du ral gri'i khyung ljang gu g.yas ral gri ste so so'i rigs kyi phyag mtshan rnams 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad rang nyid dang mtshungs pa/ de rnams kyi thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bo khyung dbus ma'i thugs kar k+ṣiṃ ljang sngon/ shar gyi thugs kar oṃ dkar po/ lho'i thugs kar pa ser po/ nub kyi thugs kar swā dmar po/ byang gi thugs kar hā ljang gu rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng rang rang gi kha dog can g.yas skor du 'khod pa/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus kyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo khros pa'i ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra rigs lnga la/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan/

oṃ shrī badz+ra ga ru ḍā ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa'i// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi bzlas pa ci nus bya/ skabs su thugs ka'i khyung yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sa gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i nus mthu yon tan kyi tshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa'ang bya'o// thun mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par byas la gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar byas nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug bsnyen pa byed na/ thun gsum mam bzhi'i rim pas gtso bor lha'i gsal snang la sems 'dzin cing sngags 'bum phrag gcig gam lnga bzla/ grub na thun thams cad dam/ ma grub na snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor mgron spyan drangs pa la gtor ma 'bul/ sgrub pa la/ gtso bor 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas bzlas pa 'bum phrag gsum bya/ de lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pas ji skad bshad pa'i las kyi tshogs thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub cing*/ spyir yang rdo rje khyung gi bsnyen sgrub gang du bgyis pa'i sa'i phyogs de'i brtan g.yo'i dug thams cad zhi bas snod bcud kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag skyed pa sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i phyir/

rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis thog kho nar rdo rje nam mkha' lding bsgom par dpal ldan rgyud las gsungs so// gnyis pa byin rlabs kyi cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍa lar rdul tshon gyis sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa bris pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir khyung rigs lnga'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung re dgod/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar khro bo'i gtor ma zur gsum pa snying gzugs mdun nor bu mig gsum pa'i dbyibs 'dra ba la dar gdugs ljang gus brgyan cing sku tsag yod na'ang 'dzug nya sha sogs dam rdzas kyis bskor/ mdun du me long la yig 'bru lnga bris pa dang*/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor gsum/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ nye logs ci bde bar gzhi bdag gtor ma/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gnyis/ rdor dril/ nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya/ de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma spyi ltar btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems nas bzlas pa bsdu pa'i bar bdag bskyed gong du bshad pa bzhin grub rjes/ tshom bu dang gtor ma gnyis ka la dmigs te a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas/ dbur brgyan ces pa'i bar rang gi rig pa dang*/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/ mchod pa byin rlabs la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzlas pa cung zad bya/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las sogs nas dbur brgyan/

ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar gsal gdab la mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song*/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la bzlas pa ci nus dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par skad cig gis khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la a mṛ ta bzla/ gnyis ka la dmigs te dbang dang khrus kyi don du a bhi ṣe ka'ang ci rigs pa bzlas mthar mchod cing bstod la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dung chos kyi chu bdud rtsi'i mchod yon tu sbreng bas bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ gtor ma gsum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab ste dang po/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum mam lngas yi dam la phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las gsol/ gnyis pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis phul/ de nyid la ar+ghaṃ sogs sbyar bas mchod/ gang gis 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin tu// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje chos srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas bsngo/ gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi ltar btang ba rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/

las kyi rdo rjes phyi rol tu slob ma rnams khrus bya/ nang du 'ongs pa na slob dpon kyis sbyong ba gsum spyi ltar byas la mtshams bcad/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin pas las bum gyi chus khrus byed du gzhug de nas sems bskyed gsal gdab sogs ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal mchog gi dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas las lha sngags kyi rim pa dngos su bstan cing*/ grub chen nā ro tā pa'i man ngag gis rnal 'byor bla med spyi dang mthun par bkral ba'i zab chos/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs shing*/ bla ma rdzong pa'i mkhas grub rnams nas rim par brgyud pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje khyung khra'i byin rlabs zab mo sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rten gnyis ka bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo khros pa'i ngo bo mkha' lding rdo rje khyung

spro na mngon rtogs ltar rgyas par brjod kyang legs so/ khra'i ye shes kyi skur dngos su gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ zhes pas thun mong spyir gsol ba btab nas/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa bye brag tu gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje khyung khra la skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ bar chad bsal ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a mṛ ta brjod cing las bum gyi chu gtor/ dngos gzhi'i skabs bla ma rdo rje khyung khra dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bi' ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po re res mtshan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba re re'i steng du/

don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re res rgyas gdab par mos te/ bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ de brtan par bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+wāṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ byin rlabs kyi gzhi dgod pa dang*/ de la brten nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi gzhi dgod pa ye shes dbab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis/ swa bhā ba sogs zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar khyed rang rnams kyi rig pa zhes dang*/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar dmigs pa spod la/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas/ byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpal rdo rje khyung khra'i sku che chung ma nges pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa nam mkha' gang ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs khyed rang rnams kyi dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rgya mtsho chen po la char babs pa ltar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ ga ru ḍā ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ/ zhes mang du brjod cing spos rol bya/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang dpal rdo rje khyung khra'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur pa brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram gyi tshul du bzhag cing*/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi phyag gi me tog de nyid slob dpon dang rdo rje khyung khra tha mi dad pa la phul ba'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra ho/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti grih+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā bā la/ des gzhi 'god pa song nas/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang*/ 'og min nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs te sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra yi// sku mchog 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis// gdug pa can rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// sku yi dbang bskur mdzad du gsol// oṃ pak+ṣiṃ ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñca bum chu sbyin cing gtor/ oṃ/ zhes gsung shing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang gi chu rgyun dkar po dang*/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'phros pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar pos dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa mgrin par bzhag la/ bcom ldan= gsung mchog=

ngag gi nyes pa 'joms mdzad pa'i// gsung gi= oṃ pak+ṣiṃ ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes gsung zhing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang gi chu rgyun dmar po dang*/ slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'phros pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dmar pos dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ gsang ba'i= ngag gi= gsung gi= bum pa snying gar bzhag la/ bcom ldan= thugs mchog= nyon mongs rnam rtog 'joms mdzad pa'i// thugs kyi= oṃ pak+ṣiṃ ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang gi chu rgyun sngon po dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun sngon pos dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi= yid kyi= thugs kyi= slar yang bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis dbang gi chu rgyun kha dog sna tshogs pa dang*/ bla ma'i gnas gsum kyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'phros pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kha dog sna tshogs pas dbang bskur bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ sa gsum gyi bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig ces brjod la me tog gtor/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas rdo rje khyung khra'i skur gyur pa mchod pa'i zhing du bzung ba yin pas mnga' dbul gyi tshul du mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pas kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas mtha' rten bkru byab srung gsum bya ba la/ thog mar bkru pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar thogs te khyed rang rnams la khrus bgyis pas nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ rnam bum gyi chu las bum du bsres pa thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ rtsa sngags dang a mṛ ta'i mthar/ rdo rje slob ma'i nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gdon thams cad= bgegs thams cad= log 'dren thams cad= steng gza'i gnod pa thams cad= 'og klu'i gnod pa thams cad= sha za smyo byed kyi gnod pa thams cad= grib dang mi gtsang ba'i= 'khon dang sdig sgrib kyi= tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru/ khar chu cung zad 'dzin tu bcug la/ byab pa'i slad du rma bya'i mdongs kyi thig le'i dbus su nyi ma la sngags kyi yi ges mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bkrus pas ma dag pa'i lhag ma thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar rtsen gyis blangs te rgya mtsho chen por phyir dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ gong gi sngags shān+tiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu a pa nā ya swā hā btags pas byab cing*/ kha nang gi chu khrus gzhong du dor/ rdo rje khyung gi lha tshogs rnams// rma bya'i mdongs kyi rnam par byon// nyon mongs dug dang bcas pa dang*// phung po'i dug rnams ma lus dang*// nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod// ces dang*/

pak+ṣiṃ gyi mthar a ya ma du ru tsa sha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing khrus chu phyir bskur la chu bo chen po'i gzhung du dor/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ sum+bha sogs drag sngags brjod la mtshams bcad/ srung ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje spyi bor bzhag pas de las rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pa byung*/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab kyis g.yogs te nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad srung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rak+ṣa rak+ṣa btags pa brjod/ slar yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje khyung gi nus mthu yis// rdo rje slob ma 'di ni bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces brjod/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// sogs shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa'ang bya'o// gsung gi rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' khyung rigs lnga so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon so so'i mthar 'khod pa'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa dang bcas lha'i nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par zhu/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rdo rje khyung khra yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ mkha' lding rdo rje khyung khra yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ sku'i rten me long dang*/ gsung gi rten sngags kyi yi ge dang*/ thugs kyi rten rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnams khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar thugs dam bskul ba'i dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung gi lha tshogs rnams/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma ltar mi 'bral zhing brtan par bzhugs par mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ yon tan dang phrin las kyi rjes gnang gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul bar 'dir yig cha snga mar/ gtor ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed par gsungs pas spro na de ltar byas kyang legs mod/ 'dir phyag len bde ba'i slad sngon du mdun bskyed dang lhan cig tu bskyed chog gcig gis so sor bskyed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ gyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khrar bskyed cing dngos su gsal ba'i dbu'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams ngo bo bla ma so so la rnam pa rdo rje khyung khra'i skur gsal ba tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/

brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur pa la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra la// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// sa gsum gdug pa 'dul ba ru// mthu stobs byin rlabs dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas gtor ma'i lha tshogs khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi// thugs sprul byin rlabs mgon po khyed// 'di la 'go zhing grogs mdzod cig /sgos kyi srung ma mdzad du gsol// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ jo bo nā ro tā pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ chos rje dge legs dpal bzang*/ rdzong chung pa kun dga' blo gros/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po/ rig 'dzin chos kyi blo gros/ rig 'dzin chos dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen ngag dbang dpal bzang*/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ grub dbang rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yongs 'dzin kun dga' bkra shis/ rje shes rab 'od zer/ 'jam mgon kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen gyi bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar thugs dam bskul zhing zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra'i lha tshogs rnams rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma ltar mi 'bral bar bzhugs nas/

bdud dang bar chad thams cad srung ba dang*/ dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes dang gong gi gsol 'debs kyi tshig dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi mthar/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swā hā/ lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs snying ga'i khyung rigs lngar gsal ba la thim pas ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ ga ru ḍa kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas shing spos rol bya/ lha 'od du zhu ba'i gtor zan dngos grub kyi tshul du cung zad re sbyin/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par bya/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang me tog gi char dbab/ des byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi grub nas mjug dam tshig khas blang sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa kha gsos bsang sbyang byin brlab/ mchod bstod bzod gsol/ badz+ra muḥs tshom bu'i ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// yang nad gdon gyis nyen pa la rkyen sel lta bur gtor ma'i byin rlabs tsam byed na/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun rten gtor ma kho na lhar bskyed cing mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ dngos gzhi maṇ+ḍal/ thun mong gi gsol 'debs/ rgyun bshags bcas kyi rjes/ slob ma lhar bskyed cing bstim/ de nas gtor dbang gong bzhin bya'o// de bzhin tu khrus chog rkyang pa byed na/ bdag bskyed dang bum pa bsgrub/ sbyong ba gsum sngon tu 'gro ba bkru byab shis brjod kyi bar gong bzhin bgyis pas kyang grub bo// gsum pa las kyi tshogs ni/ byis gdon bya 'dre mche ba'i dug

/steng gdon gza' dang 'og gdon klu// sbyar ba'i dug tu gyur pa rnams// brtag cing srung gso'i rim pa dang*// sde brgyad 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul ni// ser ba srung ba'i man ngag ste// mngon spyod drag po'i sbyin sreg bcas// las kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa'o// zhes pa ste/ rtsa ba'i yig rnying mchan dang bcas pa las shes par bya'o// bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra yi// thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin phung las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// grub gnyis dga' tshal rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rang 'dra'i blo dman rnams 'jug pa bde ba'i slad/ mnyam med gzungs kyi dpal ba dang*/ rdzong chung ba kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs dang*/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad par grags pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs dang bcas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te/ bklags pas grub par bsdebs pa sarba dā su shrī yo bha btu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
